## Global AI Builders Cup — Season 1 / shared 2027 pool

Checked 12 October 2026.

### Status

Rolling 2027 pool intake open now; season page separately advertises January 2027 applications. Current 2026 conference cohort is already in progress and cannot be entered through this intake. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply)

### Scope

Retain for civilian AI startup research; no known 3+ minimum or mandatory defense purpose found. Investment competition, not grant.

### Team minimum

Optional team-size field accepts 1–100000; this is input validation, not a published minimum-team eligibility rule. Solo-founder and sole-proprietor legal eligibility unresolved. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

### Public form fields

- Founder name: required; {'minlength': '2', 'maxlength': '120'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Email: required; {'maxlength': '255', 'type': 'email'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Startup name: required; {'maxlength': '160'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Phone: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '40', 'type': 'tel'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- LinkedIn URL: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '500', 'type': 'url'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Website URL: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '500', 'type': 'url'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- One-line startup summary: required; {'minlength': '10', 'maxlength': '280'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Problem, solution and timing: required; {'minlength': '40', 'maxlength': '4000'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- AI role in product: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '1500'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Industry: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '120'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Stage: optional in published HTML; {}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Founding year: optional in published HTML; {'min': '2000', 'max': '2100', 'type': 'number'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Location: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '160'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Pitch-format preference: required; {}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Preferred geography: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '160'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Traction: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '2000'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Monthly revenue: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '120'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Team size: optional in published HTML; {'min': '1', 'max': '100000', 'type': 'number'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Fundraising amount: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '120'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Business model: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '2000'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Team background: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '2000'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Deck URL: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '500', 'type': 'url'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Video URL: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '500', 'type': 'url'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Product/demo URL: optional in published HTML; {'maxlength': '500', 'type': 'url'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- English-pitch capability checkbox: optional in published HTML; {'type': 'checkbox'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Investment-review sharing acknowledgment: required; {'type': 'checkbox'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- Public-profile permission checkbox: optional in published HTML; {'type': 'checkbox'}. [Form](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

### Eligibility

- startup: Worldwide AI-native pre-seed/seed startups; no particular incorporation country required. No stated nationality/residency restriction. Whether unincorporated individuals or sole proprietors can receive investment is not established. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/)

- rounds: Launched rounds may add eligibility rules; pool admission is not selection. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply)

### Requirements

- artifacts: Deck, demo video and product links optional in current intake; URL limit 500 characters each. No upload field, video duration, deck pages, file-size or file-format rule visible. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- prototype_traction: Traction/revenue/AI-description inputs optional in intake. No express MVP/prototype or revenue threshold located; absence of a form requirement does not establish selection eligibility. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- language: English-pitch checkbox has no required attribute; do not present English fluency as a verified submission gate. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

- process: Five steps. Advancing from first step automatically saves a draft and emails a continuation link; links last 30 days. No form was filled, saved, advanced or submitted. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply/form)

### Attendance

Most regional rounds virtual, some local in-person; semifinals streamed. Homepage proposes Silicon Valley finale; exact venue/date unconfirmed. Intake lets applicant prefer virtual or in-person, but does not guarantee remote participation through finale. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/)

### Award

- investment: $50,000–$250,000 discretionary investment by Chief in Tech Capital, subject to diligence and negotiated terms. Competition itself takes no equity; investment is separate. Currency is printed only as $, without an explicit ISO code in audited pages. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply)

- services: Finalists advertised a $10,000 Humenta package, cloud/AI credits, coaching, produced pitch video, investor introductions and publicity; no credit amounts or vendor eligibility terms published. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/)

- payment: No fixed equity percentage, payment date, matching contribution, milestone schedule, reporting, clawback or startup-IP clause located. Private investment agreement required before treating any of these as known. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/)

### Expense Rules

- classification: Investment plus services/credits; not a reimbursement grant.

### Deadlines

- intake: Rolling intake open; no closing timestamp/timezone published. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/apply)

- season: January 2027 applications; September semifinals; October finale. Dates/timezones and final venue/count await confirmation. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/seasons/s1-27)

- regional: Homepage lists March–May 2027 rounds; same page has stale mid-2027 wording despite October finale. Treat month-level dates as announced plan, not hard deadline. [Source](https://aibuilderscup.com/)

### Unresolved

- Full round-specific rules and later-stage application not published in audited routes.

- Incorporation timing, sole-proprietor acceptance, minimum founders, age and sanctions restrictions not specified.

- No application fee, but finalist travel funding and attendance obligations unknown.

- Pool open versus January season application language must remain separated.

- Prize currency ISO code, investment instrument, dilution and contractual financial/IP conditions unresolved.

### Application data disclosure

The form states that required acknowledgement permits sharing founder contact details, startup information, traction, fundraising details and submitted links with Chief in Tech Capital for competition selection and investment review. Optional public-profile consent covers founder/startup names, product description, startup details, website and demo links. The form states contact, deck, traction, revenue, fundraising and review data remain private; this is its stated disclosure, not independently verified privacy protection. raw_findings.note_markdown:
# MOEA SBIR Phase 1

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 official application package (approved November 2025); rolling programme. No 2027 edition verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **evidence:** No minimum found; review allows at most three representatives, not at least three.

## Eligibility
- **individual:** Unincorporated individuals are not applicants. Individual application means one eligible enterprise.
- **company:** Domestic registered SME company, limited partnership or business. Paid capital <=NT$100m OR fewer than 200 regular employees. Branch offices including foreign branches and mainland investment excluded.
- **sole proprietor:** Registered business form eligible; not the same as an unregistered freelancer.
- **nationality residency:** Taiwan registration and Taiwan project execution required; nationality restriction on every founder not found. Foreign R&D personnel need actual Taiwan work and lawful residence/work status.
- **team:** No numeric personnel minimum found; insurance exceptions for fewer than five employees do not establish a one-person entitlement.

## Application and product requirements
- **stage:** Concept/feasibility validation, maximum six months.
- **submission:** Online portal; Phase 1 presentation, Phase 2 written plan and evidence. Login-only live portal fields not exhaustively visible.
- **video:** No mandatory application video found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **review:** PI normally presents; qualified R&D substitute allowed. Maximum three company attendees. Individual review30min; alliance40min. Teams remote instructions exist, but each actual meeting mode is notified separately. Employment proof due three working days before noon; presentation/responses one working day before noon.
- **execution:** Taiwan project and possible site checks; reports and three-year follow-up.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched non-dilutive R&D subsidy, not unrestricted prize
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 1500000
- **duration amount:** Phase 1 six months NT$1.5m.
- **equity:** No equity purchase in the grant rules.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Company responsible person doing project R&D must be included as R&D personnel; actual payroll, approved person-months and time allocation required. Standard personnel allocation normally <=60%, explain excess. No dividends or arbitrary founder draw.
- **office rent:** No ordinary office rent line established. Office consumables excluded.
- **travel flights:** Necessary domestic R&D/field-validation travel including documented flights; overseas travel not listed as eligible.
- **computers equipment:** Approved research equipment and software usage/depreciation prorated to project. Purchase price is not automatically reimbursable in full.
- **subscriptions API:** Software is recognized in research equipment accounting; ordinary SaaS/API subscriptions are not expressly resolved in the reviewed text. Obtain classification before budgeting.
- **matching:** Subsidy <=50%; self-funding generally should not exceed paid capital unless credible financial plan supplied.
- **reimbursement reporting:** Dedicated accounting, original invoices, payroll/timesheets and progress checks. Semiannual review; Phase 1 PI work record, Phase 2 all R&D staff work records. <=9-month project normally two instalments; longer project final15% holdback. Full advance may require equal bank guarantee. Three-year outcome tracking. Without full guarantee, subsequent instalment requires approved work/accounting reports and cumulative expenditure at least75%.
- **clawbacks:** Unspent funds and interest returned; ineligible costs/missed outputs can reduce award. False claims can trigger recovery and five-year exclusion.
- **IP:** Research outcomes and IP belong to applicant. Government retains free, nontransferable, nonexclusive research use for national/public interests. Mainland implementation is subject to applicable Taiwan investment/technology-cooperation/trade laws.
- **other:** Patent-application budget exists subject to qualified project-generated patent evidence and accounting caps; include it explicitly rather than assume excluded.

## Deadlines
- **application:** Rolling; no fixed 2026 cutoff identified.
- **timezone:** No closing time to convert.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# MOEA SBIR Phase 2

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 official application package (approved November 2025); rolling programme. No 2027 edition verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **evidence:** No minimum found; review allows at most three representatives, not at least three.

## Eligibility
- **individual:** Unincorporated individuals are not applicants. Individual application means one eligible enterprise.
- **company:** Domestic registered SME company, limited partnership or business. Paid capital <=NT$100m OR fewer than 200 regular employees. Branch offices including foreign branches and mainland investment excluded.
- **sole proprietor:** Registered business form eligible; not the same as an unregistered freelancer.
- **nationality residency:** Taiwan registration and Taiwan project execution required; nationality restriction on every founder not found. Foreign R&D personnel need actual Taiwan work and lawful residence/work status.
- **team:** No numeric personnel minimum found; insurance exceptions for fewer than five employees do not establish a one-person entitlement.

## Application and product requirements
- **stage:** R&D after demonstrated feasibility, prototypes and market/pilot verification; previous Phase 1 is not universally mandatory. One or two years.
- **submission:** Online portal; Phase 1 presentation, Phase 2 written plan and evidence. Login-only live portal fields not exhaustively visible.
- **video:** No mandatory application video found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **review:** PI normally presents; qualified R&D substitute allowed. Maximum three company attendees. Individual review30min; alliance40min. Teams remote instructions exist, but each actual meeting mode is notified separately. Employment proof due three working days before noon; presentation/responses one working day before noon.
- **execution:** Taiwan project and possible site checks; reports and three-year follow-up.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched non-dilutive R&D subsidy, not unrestricted prize
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 12000000
- **duration amount:** One year NT$6m; two years NT$12m.
- **equity:** No equity purchase in the grant rules.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Company responsible person doing project R&D must be included as R&D personnel; actual payroll, approved person-months and time allocation required. Standard personnel allocation normally <=60%, explain excess. No dividends or arbitrary founder draw.
- **office rent:** No ordinary office rent line established. Office consumables excluded.
- **travel flights:** Necessary domestic R&D/field-validation travel including documented flights; overseas travel not listed as eligible.
- **computers equipment:** Approved research equipment and software usage/depreciation prorated to project. Purchase price is not automatically reimbursable in full.
- **subscriptions API:** Software is recognized in research equipment accounting; ordinary SaaS/API subscriptions are not expressly resolved in the reviewed text. Obtain classification before budgeting.
- **matching:** Subsidy <=50%; self-funding generally should not exceed paid capital unless credible financial plan supplied.
- **reimbursement reporting:** Dedicated accounting, original invoices, payroll/timesheets and progress checks. Semiannual review; Phase 1 PI work record, Phase 2 all R&D staff work records. <=9-month project normally two instalments; longer project final15% holdback. Full advance may require equal bank guarantee. Three-year outcome tracking. Without full guarantee, subsequent instalment requires approved work/accounting reports and cumulative expenditure at least75%.
- **clawbacks:** Unspent funds and interest returned; ineligible costs/missed outputs can reduce award. False claims can trigger recovery and five-year exclusion.
- **IP:** Research outcomes and IP belong to applicant. Government retains free, nontransferable, nonexclusive research use for national/public interests. Mainland implementation is subject to applicable Taiwan investment/technology-cooperation/trade laws.
- **other:** Patent-application budget exists subject to qualified project-generated patent evidence and accounting caps; include it explicitly rather than assume excluded.

## Deadlines
- **application:** Rolling; no fixed 2026 cutoff identified.
- **timezone:** No closing time to convert.

## Public application field inventory
- **Project title** — Required [Evidence](https://sbir.sme.gov.tw/download/downloadarea/115年附件A計畫書格式(申請Phase2及Phase2_)vfIH4BeY.docx).
- **Start and end dates** — Required [Evidence](https://sbir.sme.gov.tw/download/downloadarea/115年附件A計畫書格式(申請Phase2及Phase2_)vfIH4BeY.docx).

requirements.label: Taiwan-registered business
requirements.details: Company, limited partnership or registered business established in Taiwan.

requirements.label: Meet the SME size definition
requirements.details: Paid-in capital or contribution no more than NT$100 million OR fewer than 200 regular employees; provide latest insured-unit headcount evidence.

requirements.label: Execute the R&D in Taiwan
requirements.details: Project execution location must be within Taiwan jurisdiction.

requirements.label: Pass tax, ownership and compliance exclusions
requirements.details: No relevant government-project suspension/breach, recent tax arrears or financial-crime findings, disqualifying Mainland investment, duplicate subsidy, or dissolved/suspended business. Check the full exclusions in the guide.

requirements.label: Prepare the project budget and self-funding
requirements.details: Subsidy no more than 50% of total cost. Self-funding normally cannot exceed paid-in capital without additional financial planning evidence.

requirements.label: Latest annual profit and income-tax calculation
requirements.details: Company under one year may substitute its most recent business-tax return.

requirements.label: Current staff insurance records
requirements.details: Labor-insurance roster of R&D staff plus insured-unit headcount; alternative employment/occupational accident insurance evidence where applicable.

requirements.label: National tax no-arrears certificate
requirements.details: Issued within the most recent month. Guide says one month, rather than an exact day count.

requirements.label: Local tax no-arrears certificate
requirements.details: Issued within the most recent month. Guide says one month, rather than an exact day count.

requirements.label: Signed personal-data consent forms
requirements.details: Attachment E, personally signed by the owner, project lead, contact, accountant, R&D staff and advisers participating.

requirements.label: Applicant self-check form
requirements.details: Attachment D.

requirements.label: Prepare applicable conditional documents
requirements.details: If applicable: public-official relation disclosure K; special-theme form for digital transformation/net zero; research ethics approvals or proof of review submission; adviser contracts and undertakings; patent/outsourcing cooperation evidence. Optional scoring evidence is separate.

requirements.label: Online project application form
requirements.details: Fill project application form and project content; individual portal fields need authenticated inspection.

requirements.label: Phase 2 R&D project plan
requirements.details: Use Attachment A, including quantified milestones, work plan, industrial benefit and execution ability.

requirements.label: Evidence of prior feasibility validation
requirements.details: Provide small-scale experimental or analytical results. If continuing Phase 1, that project must close and reviewers must agree first.

requirements.label: 1. Complete the online application
requirements.details: Use the official SBIR online system.

requirements.label: 2. Upload stamped documents and project content
requirements.details: Company and owner seals normally required; business-certificate authentication exempts seals on specified documents.

requirements.label: 3. Correct any missing documents
requirements.details: Within five working days after the office requests correction.

requirements.label: 4. Save the formal receipt email
requirements.details: The office sends a formal receipt once completeness is confirmed.

requirements.label: 5. Attend the project review presentation
requirements.details: Prepare supplementary evidence if requested.

requirements.label: 6. Receive the approval decision
requirements.details: Recommendation and final-review approval precede award.

requirements.label: 7. Sign the project contract if awarded
requirements.details: Submit revised approved plan, sealed contract and required payment documents.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Kaohsiung Youth General 2026

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 call closed; expenses and claim period still relevant. No 2027 edition verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1

## Eligibility
- **company:** Kaohsiung company/business or qualifying tax-registered small business; established 2023-02-23 through 2026-02-22; capital <=NT$10m and prior-year revenue <=NT$5m (proration rules apply).
- **individual:** Responsible person must be Taiwan citizen, Kaohsiung household registered, age18–45, with ten hours entrepreneurship training; not an unregistered individual grant.
- **sole proprietor:** Business/tax-registered small enterprise allowed under rules.
- **restrictions:** No special-entertainment business; no prior Youth Bureau startup grant; choose general or competitive grant; same responsible person treated as same applicant; representative change after announcement not allowed.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Digital Kaohsiung service form and scanned stamped attachments; application form now unavailable/closed.
- **training:** Ten hours qualifying entrepreneurship training, online classes permitted.
- **traction:** Existing legal operation and revenue/tax evidence; no MVP/video/deck requirement found beyond prescribed plan.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **inspection:** On-site business verification before approval; subsequent checks, results presentations and promotion cooperation.
- **location:** Kaohsiung business and household-registration conditions must be maintained during award period.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Expense reimbursement
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 80000
- **rate:** Up to70% eligible actual costs, within approved amount; not an unconditional cash prize.
- **equity:** No equity term found.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not in the eligible categories.
- **office rent:** Business-premises rent eligible up toNT$20,000/month; related-family landlord exclusions apply.
- **travel flights:** Not in listed eligible categories.
- **computers equipment:** New directly business-related equipment with unit price >=NT$10,000; administration/decor/consumables excluded. A computer is not automatically eligible.
- **subscriptions API:** Not expressly included; listed marketing website/SEO/advertisement expenses are narrower than general software subscription.
- **other:** Specified advertising, SEO, blogger promotion, sign, website and video marketing costs.
- **proof:** Invoices, payment proof, equipment photographs, rent/lease evidence, ad screenshots and analytics, account details.
- **clawbacks:** False or duplicate claims, ineligible spend or refusal of checks may lead to recovery and exclusion. Changes of business, representative or household location/cancellation during award period must be reported within seven days; two-year bar possible.

## Deadlines
- **application open:** 2026-03-18
- **application close:** 2026-04-15; clock/timezone not expressly confirmed
- **eligible cost period:** 2026-06-01 through 2026-09-30
- **claim deadline:** 2026-11-15

# Sustainability Kaohsiung Youth Startup Challenge 2026 (company track)

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 company-track competition closed. Extended online deadline supersedes original PDF.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **separate track:** Individual-team track minimum two people, one-third age18–35; do not transfer that minimum to company track. Three member rows in company form are not an explicit minimum.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Company founded on/after2017-01-01, capital <=NT$10m, responsible person18–45. Proposal must have Kaohsiung production, research, sales/service or other local connection; explicit Kaohsiung incorporation requirement not found.
- **individual:** Separate individual-team route exists; not the recorded company track.
- **sole proprietor:** Company-track wording is company; business/sole proprietor equivalence not established.
- **restrictions:** Prior2025 finalists ineligible; IP and originality declarations required.

## Application and product requirements
- **deck:** Chinese PDF,16:9, <=20slides excluding cover; business model, innovation, sustainability and team. Suggested market, competition,2024–25 financials,2026–28 projections, risks and benefits.
- **video:** No initial mandatory video found.
- **MVP traction:** Business information and later live demonstration; no universal minimum revenue found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Paper screening, online submission.
- **preliminary:** Early May physical pitch7min+5min questions.
- **programme:** Finalists must complete May–June training.
- **final:** Physical demo/pitch in June; subsequent official account records June15. Ceremony attendance conditions apply.
- **post award:** Company winners must participate in investment matching AND overseas international training itinerary; travel coverage not specified. Two-year tracking.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Cash competition prize
- **currency:** TWD
- **prizes:** [1000000, 500000, 300000]
- **tax:** Gross prizes; domestic10% withholding for qualifying amount overNT$20k, foreign20% stated in rules.
- **claim:** Claim paperwork within14days of results.
- **equity:** No equity condition stated; later investor matching does not itself mean equity awarded.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **office rent:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **travel flights:** Mandatory overseas activity may create travel cost; who pays is unresolved.
- **computers equipment:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **subscriptions API:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **spend:** Public rules do not enumerate founder salary, office rent, flights, computers or subscriptions as permitted/restricted uses. Do not label unrestricted without award confirmation.
- **matching:** No applicant match stated.
- **clawbacks IP:** Misrepresentation, infringement and rule breach can revoke award. Perpetual free worldwide licence to use/reproduce/adapt proposal for publicity.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-04-12 12:00 extended; original PDF2026-04-08 23:59 is superseded.
- **timezone:** Taiwan local time is planning assumption; no explicit timezone string found.

# AI Innovation Service R&D Subsidy 2026

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 June application pack; October1 amendment extends innovation-service implementation to2027-03-31. Latest consolidated revised form not accessible.

Decision: exclude_verified_3plus_personnel

- **personnel minimum:** 4
- **basis:** June2026 plan Annex7 requires ability analysis for at least FOUR principal project personnel; not merely four blank rows.
- **company count:** 1

## Eligibility
- **company:** Domestic company, sole proprietorship, partnership or limited partnership in J582/J62/J63 information-software services; positive equity, no mainland investment/branch route.
- **individual:** Registered qualifying enterprise required.
- **sole proprietor:** Explicitly included but four-person project requirement remains.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Industry/commercial certificate authenticated portal; electronic application and PDFs <=20MB.
- **technology:** AI innovation services or AI Agent; cybersecurity at least7% plan resources; Agent requires TrustAI proposal/test evidence for closeout.
- **team:** At least four principal-personnel capability profiles in public plan, therefore outside fewer-than-three scope.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online; no physical submission requirement found.
- **review programme:** Review and project audit obligations; exact interview venue/remote policy not established.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched R&D subsidy
- **currency:** TWD
- **innovation service maximum:** 5000000
- **AI Agent maximum:** 20000000
- **equity:** No equity purchase in grant description.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Actual formal project R&D payroll under approved budget; finance/admin staff excluded. Founder only if satisfies eligible staff/payroll conditions.
- **office rent:** No ordinary office-rent category established.
- **travel flights:** Domestic project travel category; overseas travel not established as subsidized.
- **computers equipment:** Usage/maintenance permitted under allocation rules; equipment purchase not automatically reimbursed.
- **subscriptions API:** Project cloud/software rental including approved cloud-service categories may be prorated; generic API is not automatically approved. Hardware acquisition, colocation/capital items excluded from cloud rental.
- **matching:** Subsidy no more than50%; item-level and category caps apply. Outsourcing/intangibles normally <=40%, service promotion<=10%.
- **reporting IP:** Audits and three-year follow-up; specified government intervention rights and prohibition on relevant mainland equipment/services; final signed terms not inspected.

## Deadlines

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Cross-Domain R&D

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 public guide and forms; application closed2025-12-09. No2027 call verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count minimum:** 2
- **startup company required:** True
- **warning:** Two-company consortium is not evidence that two people suffice; prior three-company minimum should not be carried forward.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Consortium of at least two domestic eligible SMEs with at least one startup, using company/business/limited partnership forms; company-level conditions apply to each.
- **individual:** Unregistered individuals cannot replace consortium enterprises.
- **nationality residency:** Domestic registration and Taiwan R&D requirements; exact individual nationality not universal.
- **startup definition:** FAQ defines startup as founded after2017-10-17, under eight years at this call; not a rolling2026/2027 date.

## Application and product requirements
- **themes:** AI, unmanned systems and net-zero. Restrict this record to civilian activity.
- **submission:** Joint plan, administrative form, slide deck and consortium/IP agreements.
- **MVP:** R&D feasibility and commercialization evidence required in plan; universal existing revenue minimum not established.

## Attendance and location
- **review:** Physical review, at most six consortium attendees, at least one representative from EACH company.
- **execution:** Project reviews and site audits; end-of-project reporting.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched non-dilutive R&D grant
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 7000000
- **equity:** No equity purchase in grant.
- **payment:** 30% retained as final payment; remaining payments follow contractual progress and cumulative expenditure. Dedicated account and ledger; unused funds/interest returned.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Actual formal R&D payroll and approved project effort. Personnel normally<=60% total; pending hires<=30% total R&D person-months. Annual role reference caps NT$1.5m PI/1.25m researcher/1m associate/750k assistant/500k research assistant, higher amounts need pay evidence. Employer retirement/severance/insurance contributions excluded. International staff must actually work lawfully in Taiwan; mainland personnel excluded from international category.
- **office rent:** No general office rent established.
- **travel flights:** Only eligible project R&D staff domestic travel tied to approved technology/outsourcing cooperation or specified field verification. Flight tickets/boarding and payment evidence required; no generic overseas travel budget.
- **computers equipment:** Approved research equipment usage/maintenance, not blanket computer purchase.
- **subscriptions API:** Exact recurring API/SaaS classification unresolved.
- **matching:** <=50% subsidy; grant<=match, match ordinarily<=paid capital unless finance plan.
- **reporting:** Work/accounting reports, KPI/site visits and three-year performance tracking/exhibitions. Consortium must allocate self-funding and bears joint payment liability. Grant paid through lead; departing member matching must be covered, and consortium falling below original membership can terminate and trigger recovery.
- **other:** Consumables normally<=25% total, explain excess; office consumables excluded. Technology/outsourcing normally<=60%, technology/IP purchase<=30%. Exhibition/competition/conference fees including approved venue/design/equipment rental and registration<=5% total. This venue category does not authorize standing office rent.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2025-12-09 17:30 for2026 projects; timezone not explicit.
- **implementation:** Approval-month first day through2026-10-15.

## Public application field inventory

- **Period** — Required administrative form [Evidence](https://sbir.sme.gov.tw/download/home/附件A：計畫申請表kxqmw2.pdf).

- **Total budget, grant, matching funds** — Required administrative form [Evidence](https://sbir.sme.gov.tw/download/home/附件A：計畫申請表kxqmw2.pdf).
- **Theme and industry** — Required administrative form [Evidence](https://sbir.sme.gov.tw/download/home/附件A：計畫申請表kxqmw2.pdf).

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# CITD digital transformation

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 Product Development CITD guide, approved December2025; recorded “digital transformation” name is too broad.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **separate consortium:** R&D alliance requires at least three enterprises; exclude that route from small-team recommendation without inferring personnel count.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Domestic manufacturing with factory registration/exemption, or qualifying technical-service business including information services. Positive equity; no rejected banking status, branches/mainland investment excluded.
- **individual:** Registered enterprise required.
- **sole proprietor:** Registered business permitted in guide.
- **project:** New product beyond domestic peer capability; not completed or already mass-produced.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Online工商憑證 authentication; prescribed plan narrative generally <=20pages, eligibility documents.
- **video:** No mandatory video found.
- **traction:** Technical feasibility and product-market evidence, not arbitrary revenue threshold.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **review:** Company representative/PI technical review; one to five attendees per company; identity and employment proof. Alliance members must each attend. Venue/remote mode notified; no blanket remote guarantee.
- **execution:** Site inspection, checkpoints and final review.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched product-development R&D grant
- **currency:** TWD
- **single company maximum:** 2000000
- **alliance maximum:** 10000000
- **equity:** No equity award.
- **security and payment:** Option1: guarantee/security20% of grant to receive at least50% after signing, balance after final approval. Option2: full-grant guarantee for100% advance. Bank guarantee valid until three months after project end; disbursement ratios subject to annual authority adjustments.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Actual approved R&D personnel compensation; founder status alone not enough.
- **office rent:** Ordinary office rent not established.
- **travel flights:** Necessary domestic R&D/technology-transfer travel; documented domestic flights possible. No general overseas entitlement.
- **computers equipment:** Research equipment/software usage/depreciation and maintenance, not general capital purchase.
- **subscriptions API:** Software recognized but SaaS/API treatment not explicitly resolved.
- **matching:** <=50% grant; self-funding ordinarily no more than capital absent financial plan.
- **reporting IP:** Progress/financial reviews and recovery for duplicate, false or ineligible claims. Government R&D IP framework applies; organiser publications of outputs have separate rights.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-02-09 17:30:59 in announcement; guide says17:30 and contains an inconsistent18:00 reference. Use stricter official announced cutoff.
- **project period:** 2026-02-10 through2026-11-30
- **timezone:** Not explicitly printed in reviewed deadline.

# Tourism Administration Digital Transformation

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 licensed travel-agency first e-commerce-system installation reimbursement; official page updated2026-04-09.

Decision: retain_conditional_three_distinct_claim_signatories

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **administrative signatories:** 3
- **basis:** Receipt/voucher instructions require handler, accountant and responsible person to be different people. This is a three-distinct-person administrative requirement, not proof of a three-founder or three-employee rule.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Licensed domestic travel agency first installing qualifying e-commerce management system in2026. This is a buyer/implementation subsidy, not a generic software-startup R&D grant.
- **individual:** No route for unregistered individual developer.
- **sole proprietor:** Eligibility depends on licensed travel-agency legal form; no independent sole-trader software route.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Install first, then registered-post reimbursement application; first-come within budget.
- **MVP traction:** Actual installed system and expenditure/results evidence required; no investor deck or pitch video.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Postal claim, no live pitch identified.
- **checks:** System/result verification and audit; remote-only guarantee not stated.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Reimbursement of system installation and first-year service
- **currency:** TWD
- **rate:** 90%
- **maximum 5 or fewer staff:** 50000
- **maximum 6 or more staff:** 100000
- **equity:** No equity condition.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not an eligible installation/service invoice category.
- **office rent:** Not an eligible category.
- **travel flights:** Not an eligible category.
- **computers equipment:** Hardware purchase not established as covered by this software implementation measure.
- **subscriptions API:** Qualifying system first-year service fee; generic developer/API subscriptions outside that approved system not established.
- **proof:** Original invoices, payment/receipt, system implementation and before/after screenshots, bank cover, budget/results documents.
- **clawbacks IP:** Fraud, duplicate claims and noncompliance can trigger recovery; application includes photo/publicity authorization.

## Deadlines
- **opened:** 2026-03-16
- **application close:** 2026-11-30 postmark; earlier exhaustion possible.
- **timezone:** Date-based postal deadline.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# OAC Marine Technology — civilian software

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 OAC marine-technology industry manual, November2025; closed. Only civilian proposals in this record.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1

## Eligibility
- **company:** Domestic sole proprietorship, partnership, limited partnership or company; positive equity; Taiwan execution. One company/responsible person application per year.
- **individual:** No unregistered individual route.
- **sole proprietor:** Explicitly eligible registered form; fewer-than-five employee insurance alternatives exist, not an explicit one-person guarantee.
- **scope:** Civilian marine AI, blue economy and net-zero software may fit; defense/unmanned military proposals excluded from this research.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** OAC project portal account/login/captcha; public81-page manual contains application, accounting and contract annexes.
- **novelty:** Future project, not already ongoing/completed; marine policy relevance, innovation and feasible measurable results.
- **video:** No application video requirement found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **selection:** Substantive review explicitly written, followed by award determination; no mandatory application interview in cited manual.
- **execution:** Project checks, reports and site audit cooperation; no remote-only guarantee.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched marine R&D subsidy
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 5000000
- **rate:** <=50%
- **equity:** No equity purchase.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Eligible actual R&D staff payroll/effort subject to approved budget; founder status alone insufficient.
- **office rent:** Project-specific site rentals can fit other operating cost; ordinary standing office overhead is not thereby approved.
- **travel flights:** Domestic project travel only in stated category; no overseas entitlement.
- **computers equipment:** Capital expenditure excluded. Approved rental of project machinery/equipment allowed; do not budget full computer purchase.
- **subscriptions API:** Software/service costs need approved classification; API subscriptions not expressly confirmed.
- **matching:** Self contribution ordinarily below paid capital, or adequate financial plan.
- **categories:** Personnel, consumables, technology transfer/contract research, domestic travel and other operating expenses. Management<=10%. Project site, transport-vehicle and vessel rentals can qualify.
- **reporting:** Quarterly at least two checkpoints, logs and financial evidence; audits and closeout.
- **clawbacks:** Nonexecution without valid reason can bring three-year exclusion; false declarations/breach can cancel and recover. Confidentiality breach can lead to ten-year ban. Contract includes representative joint-guarantee liability.
- **IP:** Possible national ownership for national security, major marine/ecological impact, stipulated contract/notice or other OAC determination; no relocation of research to mainland China. Do not promise unconditional private ownership.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-01-20; exact clock not established.
- **implementation:** Approval date through2026-11-30.

raw_findings.edition_status: 2026 first-call SIIR rules issuedDecember2025. Second call cancelled after budget allocation; no2027 call verified.

team_minimum.separate_routes: Joint route requires at least three companies; chain route at least ten shops. Those are entity/outlet requirements, not personnel counts.

application_fields.field: Company capital, equity, headcount and finances
Problem, technology, customer need and solution
Before/after service process, target market, customer value and industry impact
Chain headquarters, brand, operating model and outlet counts
International target market selection and export-expansion actions

eligibility.company: Domestic company, limited partnership or registered business, positive equity, no foreign branch/mainland investment or disqualifying banking history.
eligibility.individual: No unregistered individual route.
eligibility.limits: No conflicting ongoing government R&D at cutoff; one company/responsible person peryear; at most two awards in three years.

requirements.theme: Smart or low-carbon innovative services with actual market-validation phase and measurable closing benefits.
requirements.submission: Online application plus prescribed narrative, financial/legal evidence.
requirements.video: No mandatory application video found.
requirements.international: International advanced route requires specified target market and export expansion plan.

attendance.review: PI/project team attend review when notified; joint route each enterprise represented. Exact venue/remote alternative not established.
attendance.execution: All project R&D personnel should attend site visits; midterm and final reviews and commercialization verification.

award.type: Matched innovation-service R&D subsidy
award.equity: No equity purchase. Higher joint/chain ceilings belong to separate tracks.

components.detail: Operator classification: restricted_cash. Consult the original award fields below for component-specific amounts, conditions, current/historical status and currency. No amount is implied by this classification.
components.normalization_note: Taxonomy assessment only; raw original award fields preserve their own evidence and edition qualifiers. No mixed narrative is certified as current component terms.

expense_rules.founder_salary: Formal R&D payroll allocated to project; ordinary staff subsidy cap30%, low-carbon40%. No meal allowances, bonuses or social-benefit provisions. Founder must meet personnel conditions.
expense_rules.office_rent: No ordinary office-rent category established; office consumables excluded.
expense_rules.travel_flights: Domestic project travel subsidy<=10%; overseas travel must be self-funded.
expense_rules.computers_equipment: Approved usage/depreciation; new equipment cost/60, mixed-use and category caps apply. Not full hardware acquisition.
expense_rules.subscriptions_API: Prorated project cloud/AI IaaS/PaaS/SaaS expressly allowed; excludes hardware purchases, colocation, maintenance/capital items under cloud category. API must fit approved service and allocation.
expense_rules.matching: At least equal self-funding, ordinarily within paid capital.
expense_rules.caps: Consumables<=15%; technology/outsourcing<=60% subsidy, IP<=30%, consultants<=10%; contracts needed for relevantNT$100k+ items.
expense_rules.payment_reporting: 50% following midterm review, remaining50% following final review; invoices, payroll, project records and output verification. No upfront unrestricted prize.
expense_rules.clawbacks_IP: Noncompliant, duplicate or unproven costs recoverable; contract/government R&D rights apply. Exact final IP licence and guarantee should be checked before signature.

deadlines.second_call: Cancelled; do not plan a2026 second-round application.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# SIIR 2026

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 first-call SIIR rules issuedDecember2025. Second call cancelled after budget allocation; no2027 call verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **separate routes:** Joint route requires at least three companies; chain route at least ten shops. Those are entity/outlet requirements, not personnel counts.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Domestic company, limited partnership or registered business, positive equity, no foreign branch/mainland investment or disqualifying banking history.
- **individual:** No unregistered individual route.
- **sole proprietor:** Registered business form eligible.
- **limits:** No conflicting ongoing government R&D at cutoff; one company/responsible person peryear; at most two awards in three years.

## Application and product requirements
- **theme:** Smart or low-carbon innovative services with actual market-validation phase and measurable closing benefits.
- **submission:** Online application plus prescribed narrative, financial/legal evidence.
- **video:** No mandatory application video found.
- **international:** International advanced route requires specified target market and export expansion plan.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **review:** PI/project team attend review when notified; joint route each enterprise represented. Exact venue/remote alternative not established.
- **execution:** All project R&D personnel should attend site visits; midterm and final reviews and commercialization verification.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched innovation-service R&D subsidy
- **currency:** TWD
- **individual maximum:** 1500000
- **sports individual maximum:** 2000000
- **international individual maximum:** 5000000
- **sports international individual maximum:** 6000000
- **equity:** No equity purchase. Higher joint/chain ceilings belong to separate tracks.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Formal R&D payroll allocated to project; ordinary staff subsidy cap30%, low-carbon40%. No meal allowances, bonuses or social-benefit provisions. Founder must meet personnel conditions.
- **office rent:** No ordinary office-rent category established; office consumables excluded.
- **travel flights:** Domestic project travel subsidy<=10%; overseas travel must be self-funded.
- **computers equipment:** Approved usage/depreciation; new equipment cost/60, mixed-use and category caps apply. Not full hardware acquisition.
- **subscriptions API:** Prorated project cloud/AI IaaS/PaaS/SaaS expressly allowed; excludes hardware purchases, colocation, maintenance/capital items under cloud category. API must fit approved service and allocation.
- **matching:** At least equal self-funding, ordinarily within paid capital.
- **caps:** Consumables<=15%; technology/outsourcing<=60% subsidy, IP<=30%, consultants<=10%; contracts needed for relevantNT$100k+ items.
- **payment reporting:** 50% following midterm review, remaining50% following final review; invoices, payroll, project records and output verification. No upfront unrestricted prize.
- **clawbacks IP:** Noncompliant, duplicate or unproven costs recoverable; contract/government R&D rights apply. Exact final IP licence and guarantee should be checked before signature.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-01-30 17:30; timezone not expressly verified.
- **project period:** 2026-02-01 through2026-11-30
- **second call:** Cancelled; do not plan a2026 second-round application.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Pingtung County SBIR 2026

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 (ROC115) Pingtung guide and full form recovered from misleadingly named114 download-page URL; call closed and awards announced.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **company count:** 1
- **consortium company count:** 2
- **warning:** Three-person review limit is a maximum; two-company optional route does not prove two-person team eligibility.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Pingtung domestic SME company, limited partnership or business; capital<=NT$100m OR fewer than200 employees; relevant factory registration/exemption. No branches/mainland capital or duplicate grants.
- **sole proprietor:** Sole proprietorship and partnership explicitly accepted.
- **individual:** Unregistered person ineligible.
- **consortium:** Two eligible enterprises, different responsible persons who are not spouses or first-degree direct relatives; each cofunds; withdrawal of either terminates joint project.
- **bonuses:** Young founder18–45, company<=8years, first application, civilian digital/SDGs/local culture and rapid commercialization can score extra, not universal entry requirements.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Three paper copies plus electronic Word/PDF and attachments, postal/hand-delivery AND Google Form upload followed by telephone receipt confirmation.
- **duration:** Six to twelve months; approved extension at most two months. Form preset2026-08-01 start is template, contract approval governs.
- **video:** No initial mandatory video found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Paper to National Pingtung University Pingshang campus research shared office, administration building7F,51Minsheng East Road,Pingtung; digital upload also.
- **review:** In-person presentation, full-time employee preferably PI. Maximum three attendees/company, at most one outsourced representative; arrive30min early.
- **execution:** On-site audits and presentation, outcomes exhibitions and follow-up. No blanket remote option.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched county R&D subsidy
- **currency:** TWD
- **single company maximum:** 1000000
- **two company total maximum:** 2000000
- **rate:** <=50%, each company<=NT$1m
- **payment:** 50% at commencement, balance after final report and expenditure approval.
- **equity:** No equity purchase.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Formal eligible R&D payroll and effort; personnel normally<=60% total. Founder eligibility depends on actual R&D/payroll, not ownership.
- **office rent:** Not in the listed eligible categories.
- **travel flights:** No general travel category in this programme accounting schedule.
- **computers equipment:** Approved equipment usage/depreciation and maintenance; caps and property-list evidence; operational rental can fall under outsourcing. Not blanket computer purchase.
- **subscriptions API:** Technology/IP acquisition includes software/database; recurring SaaS/API eligibility not explicitly resolved.
- **categories:** R&D personnel, materials, equipment use/maintenance, technology transfer and contract research, qualified patent application expenses.
- **matching:** <=50% grant; self funds ordinarily below capital or financial plan.
- **reporting:** Dedicated account/ledger, paid original vouchers in project dates; all participating-person data consents; project results and follow-up. Midterm/final work and accounting reports, mandatory accountant certification for final claim; audit fee self-funded, cannot be project cost. Three-year outcome tracking. Weekly work records may be required to remedy delayed progress.
- **clawbacks:** Unused funds/interest returned; false or duplicate grant/noncompliance may terminate and recover full grant plus interest.
- **IP:** Research/IP belongs to applicant, but results generally may not be produced/used outside Taiwan jurisdiction for two years from generation without the prescribed approval exception.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-07-17 15:00; time zone not explicitly printed, Taiwan local planning assumption.
- **implementation:** Contract starts first day of approval month or next month; six to twelve months.
- **award contract:** Sign within30days of approval letter; justified approved extension at most two months.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Taipei SITI R&D

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
Current enduring SITI rules linked in2026; application form dated2026-01-01, plan2024-02-27 and accounting2023-08-07 still officially linked. These dates are disclosed, not represented as newly issued2026 rules.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **distinct roles minimum:** 2
- **basis:** PI and accountant cannot be same person. Contact must be formal employee. No three-person minimum established.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Taipei-registered company/business or foreign-company Taiwan branch, registered at least one year.
- **sole proprietor:** Registered business route permitted.
- **individual:** Unregistered individual ineligible.
- **traction:** At least one recognized market proof: prior-year nonzero sales, capital increase or third-party pilot validation.
- **nationality:** Taipei registration is key; foreign branch expressly possible, unlike many central grants.

## Application and product requirements
- **submission:** Prescribed application and R&D plan plus attachments; apply between six months and one day before start.
- **project:** General innovation R&D8–18months; distinguish innovation acceleration and thematic subtracks.
- **video:** No mandatory video found.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Formal application; no account action performed.
- **review:** PI presents, substitute needs permission; latest2026 meeting notice maximum3attendees, external advisor/vendor at most1. Physical meeting notified.
- **execution:** Corporate-premises checks, milestone and final report verification.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Matched general innovation R&D subsidy
- **currency:** TWD
- **maximum:** 5000000
- **rate:** <=50%
- **other tracks:** Innovation accelerationNT$3m and thematicNT$2m are separate, with different cost eligibility.
- **payment:** 50% first instalment; balance after final report and accountant audit.
- **security:** First instalment requires bank performance guarantee or pledged term deposit equal to30% of that instalment; validity extends at least three months after project end.
- **equity:** No equity purchase.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Actual eligible full-time R&D salary supported by insurance, payroll and effort; foreign personnel must work lawfully in Taiwan. Founder draw/dividends not qualified by default.
- **office rent:** Shared table venue-rent/decor category is ONLY for Innovation Acceleration commercial events, not general R&D and not permanent premises.
- **travel flights:** Shared table economy overseas flights/accommodation category ONLY for Innovation Acceleration; do not import into general R&D.
- **computers equipment:** Research equipment usage/maintenance allowed; full laptop purchase is not generally reimbursable.
- **subscriptions API:** Software/IP acquisition may qualify within approved outsourcing; cloud market-validation space under market expansion is acceleration-only. General recurring API eligibility unresolved.
- **other:** General R&D personnel, consumables, research equipment use/maintenance, outsourcing and patent costs subject to rules. Office consumables excluded. Accountant audit fee cannot be charged to project.
- **reporting:** Original vouchers, salary tax reporting, budget-purpose compliance, accountant-certified final report. Feedback/contribution obligations included in approved plan.
- **clawbacks:** Unspent grant returned within15days of closeout; non-return can trigger collection/litigation and associated costs. Other false/noncompliant claims subject to recovery.

## Deadlines
- **application:** Rolling; one day to six months before planned start; maximum two applications in any one-year period.
- **project duration:** Eight to eighteen months.
- **2027:** No specific2027 revision verified; recheck enduring rules before submission.

# ASPN Sports Tech Accelerator Batch 3

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
Batch3/2026 public form and site; review results advertised earlyApril2026. Form still displayed, but open intake and deadline not confirmed. No2027 batch verified.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** None

## Eligibility
- **company:** Sports-tech startup; form permits pre-revenue and “no formal company structure yet” response, so incorporation is not clearly universal.
- **individual:** Unincorporated founding team may be contemplated; explicit solo entitlement not established.
- **nationality residency:** Country selector and Asia-Pacific/global programme; no verified Taiwan nationality/residency rule.
- **stage:** Stage choices begin first test users, first paying customers, breakeven and scaling; idea-only route not established.

## Application and product requirements
- **deck:** English PDF pitch deck required. Visible label100MB but HTML upload configuration300MB; use stricter100MB until clarified.
- **logo:** PNG logo required, same visible100MB/backend300MB inconsistency.
- **video:** Demo video URL optional.
- **traction:** Revenue status can be pre-revenue; product description, stage and capital questions required.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Public online form.
- **interview:** Mode/location not published in text reviewed.
- **programme:** Sports pilots, mentoring, investor and regional event access; selected country/event preferences are not proof that all travel is compulsory.
- **final:** Mandatory demo-day location and remote alternative unresolved.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Acceleration/services and commercial/investor connections
- **guaranteed cash:** None
- **equity:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **headline caution:** Cumulative NT$1bn invested/commercial activity on site is alumni/programme history, not a guaranteed grant to each participant.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **office rent:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **travel flights:** Regional events mentioned but travel support and compulsory attendance not established.
- **computers equipment:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **subscriptions API:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **spend:** No verified cash award or public expense-reimbursement schedule; salary/rent/flights/computers/API entitlements cannot be assigned.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** Not found; live form visibility does not prove intake open.
- **selection:** EarlyApril2026 review-results announcement referenced.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# SparkLabs Taiwan

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
Visible application heading Batch11/2026Spring, browser title2023Fall and body2025Winter conflict. Programme site says rolling/upon acceptance. No2027 application confirmed.

Decision: retain_as_equity_investment_not_grant

- **personnel minimum:** None
- **basis:** Cofounder fields optional; founding-story asks about cofounders. Neither is conclusive proof of required minimum.

## Eligibility
- **company:** Early-stage globally oriented scalable startup; current public form asks incorporation city/country but exact legal-incorporation prerequisite not clarified.
- **individual:** No verified prohibition on solo founder, but no certified unincorporated route.
- **nationality residency:** No universal Taiwan nationality restriction found; founder base and languages requested.
- **traction:** Early traction preferred; existing overseas operations not mandatory.

## Application and product requirements
- **deck:** Required pitch deck<=15MB, English preferred.
- **video:** Demo URL optional; not mandatory video.
- **fulltime:** Required full-time commitment question offers yes/no/other; a question is not proof that only yes qualifies.
- **process:** Three interviews, three-month programme, six-minute DemoDay pitch.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online.
- **interviews:** Three rounds; precise physical/remote requirement unpublished in reviewed sources.
- **programme:** Three months; Taipei office support; relocation/residency minimum not established.
- **final:** Six-minute DemoDay; exact location and mandatory remote/in-person option require organiser confirmation.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Equity investment plus services
- **currency:** USD
- **standard investment:** 100000
- **equity:** Up to7% under standard public terms; final investment contract controls.
- **services:** Mentoring, office, legal/accounting support described with no additional programme fee; not additional cash.
- **not grant:** True

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **office rent:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **travel flights:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **computers equipment:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **subscriptions API:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **spend:** Public application/programme pages do not set salary, rent, travel, computer or API budget permissions. Investment agreement, runway expectations and corporate duties control; no unrestricted-spend assurance.
- **reimbursement:** No separate expense reimbursement schedule verified.
- **IP clawback:** Investment contract, investor rights, founder vesting, IP assignment and termination terms not public in reviewed form.

## Deadlines
- **application:** Site describes rolling acceptance; exact Batch11 deadline not verified.
- **edition conflict:** 2026Spring heading vs2025Winter body vs2023Fall browser title; reconfirm current cohort before planning.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Chunghwa Telecom Smart Innovation Applications Competition 2026

Checked 12 October 2026.

## Edition and scope
2026 competition application closed; shortlist/final/ceremony forthcoming as of2026-10-12.

Decision: retain_for_diligence

- **personnel minimum:** 1
- **personnel maximum:** 6
- **evidence:** Rules explicitly allow one to six participants; at least one Taiwan national.

## Eligibility
- **individual:** Social track permits individuals, startups and companies.
- **company:** No universal incorporation prerequisite for social track.
- **sole proprietor:** May enter as person/team; separate company proof depends on entered identity.
- **nationality:** At least one team member must be Taiwan citizen.
- **student:** Separate campus route needs student identification; up to two advisors; minors need guardian consent.
- **restrictions:** Prior2022–25 winning work cannot be reused; no pre-existing CHT commercial collaboration on entered work by final2026-10-31; own IP/licences required. Multiple entries allowed but highest final award rule applies.

## Application and product requirements
- **proposal:** Word/PDF A4<=20MB, recommended15pages excluding cover/contents/references, font>=12pt; seven required sections.
- **video:** Optional initial video.
- **final:** Final consent and pitch deck mandatory;12-minute pitch/live demo plus award exhibition.

## Attendance and location
- **application:** Online member account; email/password login hides submission controls.
- **final:** Physical final2026-10-31; Banqiao training academy tentative, another schedule labels venueTBA; verify organiser notice.
- **ceremony:** 2026-11-26 tentative, exhibition/award participation required per rules.
- **remote:** No remote alternative found.

## Award and conditions
- **type:** Gross cash prizes, not credits or equity investment
- **currency:** TWD
- **social main prizes:** [250000, 200000, 150000, 100000]
- **social finalists:** Ten finalistsNT$10,000 each; award stacking governed by rules.
- **special:** TwoNT$50,000 special prizes.
- **campus separate:** NT$200k/150k/100k plus threeNT$50k and tenNT$10k finalist prizes.
- **tax:** 10% withholding at qualifyingNT$20,000+ threshold stated; actual residency tax obligations require checking.
- **payment:** Typically one to two months after ceremony.
- **equity:** No equity condition in competition rules.

## Spend, matching, reporting and recovery
- **founder salary:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **office rent:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **travel flights:** Attendance costs/reimbursement not specified.
- **computers equipment:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **subscriptions API:** Not established in the public material reviewed; do not assume permitted or prohibited.
- **spend:** Rules reviewed do not state permitted uses for salary/rent/flights/computers/API. Absence of a budget schedule is not certification of unrestricted use.
- **matching:** No financial match stated.
- **IP:** Creator retains IP; publicity/event records licence granted; CHT priority for commercial negotiation, not automatic ownership transfer.
- **clawbacks:** Fraud, plagiarism, ineligibility and rule breaches can revoke award and require return.

## Deadlines
- **application close:** 2026-09-18 12:00
- **shortlist:** 2026-10-16
- **final:** 2026-10-31
- **award announcement:** 2026-11-02
- **ceremony:** 2026-11-26 tentative
- **timezone:** Taiwan local planning assumption; explicit timezone label not found.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Eureka Globalstars Taiwan 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 call verified and closed. Expected project start April 2027; no 2027 application call verified. Taiwan download page currently links an August 2025 general manual; historical/manual evidence is separated below.

Team minimum: At least 2 independent for-profit companies across Taiwan and one participating economy; this is an ORGANISATION minimum, not a three-person founder minimum.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- applicant: Taiwan company plus independent for-profit company in Austria, Finland, Sweden or Netherlands; Taiwan grant does not directly fund universities/research bodies (subcontract or self-fund allowed).

- individual_soleprop: Individual applicant cannot meet company consortium rule. General 2025 A+ manual permits sole proprietorships/partnerships, but the specific 2026 call says companies: sole-proprietor eligibility remains unresolved.

- nationality: Company establishment is specified; founder nationality/residency not separately stated.

- submission: Eureka portal online, account required. National application separately required.

- review: Taiwan may require review meetings and supplementary information; remote permission and venue not specified.

# Presidential Hackathon Domestic Track 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 domestic rules and FAQ verified; submission closed. No 2027 call verified.

Team minimum: Maximum 10; no numeric minimum established. Government staff may apply in personal name; non-government entrants must form a team, minimum unspecified.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- applicants: Government organisations/staff, private organisations, public and students. No incorporation required by reviewed rules.

- nationality_residency: No general nationality/residency condition established in domestic documents; do not treat silence as guaranteed foreign eligibility.

- proposal: Must not already be underway, tendered, or have applied for government budget, including phased projects. Original work and attribution required.

## Product and application requirements

- theme: Smart agriculture, safety and sustainability; smart governance, safe society and sustainable transition.

- initial: Proposal form only; FAQ explicitly says no initial slides/video.

- final: Physical presentation and observed practical work; prototype/testing/cooperation progress assessed.

- AI: Declare use, tool names, purpose, functions and scope; AI-generated core code is discouraged, not phrased as automatic disqualification.

## Attendance and location

- submission: Online proposal; registration/login.

- initial: Document review.

- programme: Mentoring September 18–November 10; workshop October 14.

- final: Physical final review November 11; venue/remote exception not established. Award ceremony December 13 (tentative schedule).

## Award and commercial terms

- cash: Five excellent teams receive TWD200,000 each.

- other: Trophies/certificates, mentoring and cloud resources based on assessed needs; later government implementation support is not an automatic extra cash award.

- tracking: Winning policy implementation tracked quarterly.

- IP: Broad free, worldwide/time-unlimited nonprofit use/adaptation/sublicensing of supplied promotional materials and likeness; materials rule excludes dashboard/module body itself.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- rent: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- travel: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- computers: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- API_subscriptions: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- reimbursement_match: Cash prize exists, but no spending schedule or unrestricted-use promise established; no matching requirement found.

- clawback: Ineligibility, non-original/false submissions can cancel participation; full payment terms not published in reviewed pages.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: July 31–August 31 2026; cutoff hour/timezone not explicit in PDF. Taiwan local time is planning assumption only.

- final: November 11; winner list November 12; ceremony December 13, all marked tentative.

# ikigai Launchpad Fall 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

Record name is Fall 2026; form explicitly closes Fall after September 11. Current programme site announces Spring 2027, dates/deadline TBA. Treat present terms as current, not proof Fall contract was identical.

Team minimum: 1; co-founder explicitly not required.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- individual_company: Can apply without any entity. Accepted founders typically establish a US entity to receive investment. Worldwide founders accepted; no Taiwan entity prerequisite.

- stage: Idea-to-MVP through friends/family, pre-seed and seed; already-funded founders eligible. Technical/domain credibility required.

- commitment: Full time or ready to become full time; able to join Taipei.

## Product and application requirements

- application: English concise answers; seven-page Tally form introduction lists question categories.

- video: Short founder/team intro video requested; duration/upload requirements not visible.

- deck: First interview is 20 minutes and explicitly requires no pitch deck; do not infer no deck ever.

## Attendance and location

- submission: Online.

- interviews: Two interviews; first 20 minutes. Remote format not confirmed.

- programme: All co-founders expected on-site Taipei for core 10-week programme; office provided.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Equity-linked investment, not grant.

- amount: USD100,000 via SAFE for 8%; no extra programme fee; possible follow-on not guaranteed.

- in_kind: Office, mentoring, introductions, workshops and corporate perks.
