# A+早期新創補助計畫

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 new programme; applications through December 31 2027. Full 70-page official manual reviewed in relevant application, contract and accounting sections; file cover June 2026, download page updated October 1. Search PDF title is erroneous; cover/content are A+ early-stage.

Team minimum: Single enterprise; no minimum founder/employee count stated. Three TARGET CUSTOMERS required, not three founders.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- company: Taiwan-registered company under 3 years at receipt, positive net worth, not bank-refused or PRC-invested. Individuals/sole-proprietorships are not included in company-only eligibility.

- product: Working functional prototype and independently developed difficult-to-replace technology required. No mature-tech integration, reselling, routine expansion or marketing-only project.

- evidence: Market/customer interaction proof (LOI/MOU/test/site intent) and at least 3 target customers with needs/use case/contact stage; financial capacity evidence.

## Product and application requirements

- MVP: Functional prototype at application; aim for productisation and commercial results.

- deliverables: Year 1 product/prototype validation and at least one formal order; year 2 at least three formal orders in same target market; year-2 commercial outcomes normally ≥50% subsidy. Technical checkpoints at least every 6 months; outcome checkpoint every 12.

- submission: Paper package to Taipei office plus electronic files to rye@tdp.org.tw.

- video: No standalone video mandate found.

## Attendance and location

- review: Required notified pitch/Q&A meeting; remote permission not stated.

- programme: Periodic technical/financial checks and final report; no residential accelerator requirement.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Restricted R&D/productisation grant.

- cap: Normally up to TWD20,000,000 over 2 years, ≤50% project total; remainder self-funded.

- payment: Contract and staged disbursement; security and reconciliation apply, not freely spendable prize.

- IP: IP clearance required; contract rights and public-benefit obligations apply.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Only genuine project R&D performed by company-hired personnel, apportioned with time/R&D records and payroll/payment proof; founder title alone is insufficient. Administrative/accounting/project-management work excluded.

- salary_items: Base pay, role/professional allowances, overtime, tax-exempt meals and actually paid bonuses can qualify; employer pension/severance/labour-health insurance excluded.

- rent: No ordinary office/home rent category. Professional R&D software, cloud equipment and bandwidth rentals may qualify as approved apportioned equipment use.

- computers: R&D computer/IT equipment monthly use cost C/36 × project use/months; other equipment C/60. Not full purchase cash reimbursement; administrative equipment excluded.

- travel: Domestic travel for listed R&D personnel; consultant/expert travel and fuel subsidies excluded. No foreign-travel approval established.

- API_subscriptions: Cloud/R&D software rental categories supported; API charges not specifically named, so require classification/approval and project-use evidence.

- other: Consumables, intangible assets, commissioned R&D, verification and patent application categories. Receipts, contracts, payment proof and approved changes required.

- clawback: Termination returns unspent/nonconforming subsidies plus interest; rescission can recover all paid subsidy plus interest, normally within 30 days. Serious breaches can bar grants 1–5 years.

- reporting: Periodic work/financial reports, R&D logs, technical checks, final report and post-award outcome/promotional cooperation.

## Dates and deadlines

- opening: One month after June 16 2026 notice (July 16 by calendar calculation); verify operational receipt start if applying.

- closing: 2027-12-31; explicit cutoff hour not located. Rolling review.

# TiBOOST Innovation Growth Program 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 competition verified; applications closed October 5, finalists pending October 23.

Team minimum: No member-count limit; all participating members must be 18 by deadline. No minimum stated.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Registered domestic/international startup company; no PRC incorporation, >30% direct/indirect PRC ownership or PRC control. Not listed on Taiwan Innovation Board.

- traction: At least one external fundraising round OR initial market validation such as revenue/users. AI-related technology in specified AI ten-construction themes.

- individual_soleprop: Company法人 registration required; unincorporated individuals not eligible; sole-proprietor acceptance not established.

## Product and application requirements

- submission: Online questionnaire plus registration, sealed non-PRC declaration, ≤25-page business plan PDF (excluding appendices), ≤20-page deck.

- video: No video requirement on public page. Supporting photos/media/certificates/awards optional.

- review: Market 25%, solution 20%, business model 20%, team 15%, capital-market readiness 20%.

## Attendance and location

- submission: Online; closed questionnaire no longer exposed.

- final: Mandatory in-person pitch and Q&A November 10, no online participation per FAQ. Venue not verified.

- travel: Foreign-incorporated finalists may claim airfare/lodging up to USD1,500 with proof, round-trip dates must include November 10. Domestic companies: return high-speed rail plus accommodation up to USD200.

## Award and commercial terms

- cash: First TWD2,500,000; second TWD1,500,000; third TWD1,000,000.

- investment: VC/capital-market introductions are opportunities, no guaranteed investment or equity term published.

- other: Travel reimbursement is separate from prize.

- founder_salary: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

# INNOPAD TAIPEI × Mighty Net Startup Accelerator Grant Program

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

Official July 20 2026 recruitment announcement verified; no dated deadline or 2027 edition established.

Team minimum: Not specified; do not interpret as solo approval.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Domestic/international startup established less than 8 years at joining. Selected teams must be Taipei-registered or commit to Taipei company registration within 6 months.

- stage: Preference for pre/post-angel growth teams that completed PoC and are preparing PoB.

- focus: Smart living, agriculture, logistics or healthcare.

- individual_soleprop: Company-oriented recruitment; unincorporated/sole-proprietor route and nationality/residency not expressly determined.

## Product and application requirements

- application: Public announcement provides organiser contact but no readable application template/form link.

- product: Industrial application potential and PoC-to-PoB focus; no public required video/deck lengths or revenue threshold found.

## Attendance and location

- location: INNOPAD Taipei, Nangang Depot Social Housing floors 3–4; factory and city PoC opportunities.

- residency: May apply for base seats; registration address usable after 3 months residence from contract signature. Attendance minimum and remote permission unresolved.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Verified support is in-kind space, PoC access, mentoring, matchmaking and exchanges. Despite English “Grant Program” title, no cash grant amount established.

- space: Limited first-year free seats allocated by need; additional paid seats possible.

- investment: Investor matchmaking/Demo Days do not promise investment.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- rent: Limited base seating support only; no housing/office reimbursement promise.

- travel: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- computers: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- API_subscriptions: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- IP_reporting_clawback: Contract and PoC conditions not exposed; not unrestricted funding.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: No deadline in reviewed announcement; availability not guaranteed by old recruitment title.

- registration: Taipei registration within 6 months of joining; address application after 3 months residence.

## Public application checklist

- Application form fields — No accessible public application form in reviewed announcement; cannot enumerate required/optional fields. ([source](https://www.might.com.tw/en/news/mightynetxinnopadtaipei-program-1th-en/))

## Unresolved / access limitations

- Public announcement is not a complete application kit.

- Cash amount, fees, equity, team size, attendance, application cutoff and PoC/IP agreement remain unresolved.

## Sources and edition control

- [Mighty Net official recruitment](https://www.might.com.tw/en/news/mightynetxinnopadtaipei-program-1th-en/) — 2026; date 2026-07-20

# 智策AI：2026資策會AI創新實戰大賽

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 competition verified. Individual registration closed October 11; proposal submission remains October 18 for already registered teams.

Team minimum: 1–5 participants, plus at least one institutional supervising professor; professor not described as competing team member.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- individual: Taiwan college/university enrolled students (undergraduate/master) or 2026 graduates, any major/year; all members provide eligibility evidence. Cross-campus teams allowed; one team/person.

- company_nationality: Student competition, no company required; nationality rule not expressly stated, institutional student status is essential.

## Product and application requirements

- proposal: One A4 page team/motivation plus about two A4 pages proposal/execution plan, Word AND PDF. Filename topic_team. Topic from AI tech/industry/cybersecurity areas.

- mentor: At least one campus professor with signed consent. Cybersecurity tests/data must be authorised.

- final: 15-minute in-person presentation plus 5-minute questions; report/slides required December 13. No initial video requirement found.

## Attendance and location

- submission: Every member registers personally online; signed declarations, undertakings, consents and professor consent emailed to chenchihung@iii.org.tw. Leader sends proposal.

- programme: October 30 exchange event; November 2–December 11 mentoring/practice.

- final: December 17 on-site presentation; Taipei Da’an event location stated, exact venue not provided in page; remote option not stated.

## Award and commercial terms

- cash: TWD50,000 / 30,000 / 20,000 for top three; three elite prizes TWD10,000 each.

- certificate: All finalist members completing presentation receive certificate.

- clawback: False/forged identity or eligibility evidence can cancel entry/award and recover prize/money/benefits.

# Kaohsiung Local SBIR 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026/ROC115 guide, cost rules, contract and actual A/B/C forms inspected. Closed; no 2027 call verified.

Team minimum: No founder headcount minimum. Single enterprise or exactly 2 independent eligible enterprises jointly.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Company/business/factory registered in Kaohsiung; capital ≤TWD100m OR fewer than 200 employees; project executed in Kaohsiung. Registered sole-proprietor business route exists; private individual alone does not qualify.

- exclusions: PRC investment, branches, related-party joint partners, duplicate/already-developed projects; tax arrears or serious environmental/labour/food/disability violations within 3 years, major public-contract breach within 5 years/suspension and specified financial offences. One annual application per company/responsible person; maximum 3 Kaohsiung awards in preceding 5 years.

- nationality: Founder nationality not independently restricted in reviewed rules; Taiwan local registration and PRC investment restrictions apply.

## Product and application requirements

- duration: 6 or 9 months; reserve awards 7 months; 6-month project may extend 1 month under rules.

- application: Phase 1 A application and approximately 4-page B concept; invited phase 2 detailed C plan. Word files ≤25MB. Financial, employment and compliance evidence required. No video specified.

- product: Innovative R&D or services with technical/commercial feasibility, measurable milestones and local impact; not subsidy for a finished product.

## Attendance and location

- review: Written concept screening then presentation review; project head/accounting participation as requested. Final presentation explicitly required by contract; remote permission not stated.

- execution: Kaohsiung operations and monitoring/site checks; not an overseas remote accelerator.

## Award and commercial terms

- cash: Single ≤TWD1m; two-company joint ≤TWD2m and ≤TWD1m/company. Restricted R&D subsidy, ≤50% total eligible project cost.

- match: Self-funding required; normally within paid-in capital or a documented financing plan.

- payment: Two instalments: first after contract; final after financial/technical closeout and accepted revisions. Amount adjusted to actual eligible expenditure, not flat prize.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Only genuine formal R&D staff project time; founder title alone insufficient. Eligible base/role/technical/manager allowances; overtime, bonuses, pensions, insurance and meals excluded. Personnel normally ≤60% budget, specified sectors 70%; excess justified. Management ≤4 person-months/year; new hires ≤30% R&D person-months.

- rent: No general office/housing rent expense head established.

- travel: No standalone travel head established.

- computers: R&D equipment/software use allocation, not unrestricted full purchase. General office equipment excluded.

- API_subscriptions: Not specifically resolved; must fit approved eligible software/equipment/technical category.

- other: Consumables normally ≤25%, no ordinary stationery; technical transfer/commissioned research ≤50%; advisors ≤TWD10,000/month; domestic patents ≤30,000 and foreign ≤100,000 under limits.

- accounting: Dedicated bank account and separate ledger, originals and monthly actual-cost withdrawals; interest and unused/ineligible funds returned. Midterm and final reports; final draft accounting/report within 10 days of end, revised within 15 days of approval, CPA certification.

- IP: Applicant owns or co-owns research. Government research licence and public-interest/non-use intervention rights; no overseas implementation before obligations complete without written approval.

- clawback: Unused/non-project costs recovered; breach may terminate and demand refund/damages. Subsequent monitoring and records inspection apply.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: 2026-06-17 17:00. Taiwan UTC+8 is local-time interpretation; notice does not separately label timezone.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# NDF Business Angel Investment

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

Current programme page and September 1 2026 guidelines/download listing checked; public English first-application form inspected. Continuous programme through 2030, not an annual prize.

Team minimum: No founder minimum published; normally at least one qualifying angel co-investor and one mentor, with committee exceptions.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Taiwan registered company or overseas company with substantive Taiwan operating entity; establishment or cash capital-increase investment. Unlisted.

- age_size: Normally within 8 years and paid-in capital/cumulative funding ≤TWD100m; exceptions through investment committee.

- individual_soleprop: Investment in company equity; individuals/sole proprietors do not independently meet company investment structure. Founder nationality unspecified; PRC investment/related-party checks apply.

- co_investment: Founder/team/related-person money does not count as qualifying angel investment. Government ownership must remain below 50%.

## Product and application requirements

- proposal: Business/investment plan, shareholding and financial diligence, commercial/technology evidence and mentor/co-investor arrangements. No universal video/MVP threshold published; equity valuation and feasibility scrutinised.

- valuation: High valuation may require business/R&D growth support or two-year anti-dilution protections.

- instrument: Published English form includes SAFE checkbox, but current operating rules emphasise same share class/price/rights/timing. SAFE eligibility cannot be assumed from checkbox alone.

## Attendance and location

- review: Investment review presentations and due diligence; interview location/remote option not stated.

- after_award: Quarterly financial/operating information, material-event notices, governance and site visits; Taiwan substantive operation required.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Equity investment, NOT non-dilutive grant. Negotiated dilution and shareholder rights.

- amount: Normally first investment ≤TWD20m; up to TWD30m where qualifying ≥USD1bn institutional investor participates, with NDF amount no greater than that institution. Subsequent cumulative limit TWD100m.

- green_channel: ≤TWD3m, with angel amount at least NDF amount.

- ratio: If NDF exceeds 50% of financing round, new investor(s), not prior shareholders, must contribute at least 50% of NDF amount. Same-round economic terms normally aligned.

- guarantee: Caps are not entitlements; diligence, committee and investment agreements control.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- rent: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- travel: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- computers: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- API_subscriptions: Not established in the reviewed public sources; do not treat as approved or unrestricted.

- budget: Investment working capital is not a reimbursement menu or unrestricted personal cash. Permitted uses, reserved matters and any repayment/default rights depend on signed agreements.

- reporting_IP: Quarterly reporting, governance and material-change notices. No blanket assignment of all IP or founder salary permission established.

## Dates and deadlines

- programme: Applications operate through 2030-12-31 according to current page; no fixed 2027 annual window verified.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Digital Service Innovation Subsidy 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 April official ADI 88-page manual inspected via official public-university mirror. Supplied plan_detail_2 URL is stale 2023 material and must not govern 2026. Closed; no 2027 call verified.

Team minimum: One enterprise applies; no numeric employee/founder minimum published.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Taiwan registered sole proprietorship, partnership, limited partnership or company in J582/J62/J63 digital industries; positive equity, not bank-refused. Branches and PRC-invested businesses excluded.

- track: Digital innovation, enterprise/consumer services, sustainability or core AI with proprietary innovative R&D. Completed existing technology not eligible.

- limits: One application; generally no more than 3 concurrent government projects for same enterprise/responsible person, with stated exceptions; no more than 2 ADI R&D subsidies in preceding 3 years.

- nationality: Founder citizenship not separately specified, but PRC staff/ICT and investment restrictions apply.

## Product and application requirements

- application: Business-certificate-authenticated online submission, financial/declaration documents and mixed online/uploaded PDF proposal ≤20MB. Review deck required. No general application video requirement found.

- security: Cybersecurity budget ≥7% total; security rating before contracting and at end; third-party app testing if app delivered. Prohibits PRC-origin AI models through API/MCP and specified PRC-brand ICT/software/cloud and data storage/transfers, including relevant Hong Kong/Macao restrictions.

## Attendance and location

- selection: Presentation and requests for additional evidence; physical versus remote review not established.

- execution: Technical and financial monitoring, semiannual reports and final review; no residential accelerator requirement. Outcome follow-up for at least 3 years.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Restricted, matched R&D grant ≤TWD15m/project, ≤50% eligible total cost; project ≤2 years.

- match: At least 50% own financing.

- payment: Initial payment requires bank performance guarantee; dedicated account/separate books. Further disbursement linked to prior work and ≥75% prior cost execution. Unspent balance/interest returned. Budget approval governs.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Eligible only for actual approved R&D employment/project time with payroll/time evidence; no founder living stipend.

- rent: General office/housing rent not an established expense head.

- travel: Approved domestic R&D/project travel; not blanket international travel.

- computers: Allocated approved R&D equipment/software use; cannot assume full laptop purchase reimbursed.

- API_subscriptions: Approved professional R&D software and cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS rental may qualify using project allocation or incremental cost, excluding setup/consultancy/one-off fees. API service is not automatically accepted, and prohibited-origin AI restrictions still apply.

- other: Personnel, consumables, equipment use/maintenance, intangible technology/commissioned R&D/verification, domestic travel and innovation promotion categories. Technology/research group ≤40%; promotion ≤10%. Specified consumables/technology/research/verification/promotion subsidy share under 50%.

- accounting: Invoices, payment proof, assets/cloud allocation and payroll/time records; final financial audit. Changes require approval.

- IP_clawback: Company generally retains results subject to governmental public-interest/research intervention rights. Misuse, false claims and breach can trigger recovery and 1–5-year disqualification; not unrestricted cash.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: 2026-05-18, submit by 16:59:59 before system closes 17:00. Taiwan UTC+8 is local-time interpretation; no separate timezone label verified.

- future: No verified 2027 application dates.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Digital Startup Application Reward 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

June 2026 ADI 48-page manual and annexes inspected via official university mirror. Supplied plan_detail_1 page is stale 2023. Programme execution reaches June 30 2027, but 2026 intake closed.

Team minimum: No numeric founder/employee minimum.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Taiwan sole proprietorship, partnership, limited partnership or company founded on/after 2018-01-01, digital industry J582/J62/J63; positive equity, no branches or PRC investment.

- product: Proprietary digital product/service, not only reseller; market validation/PoB/PMF and credible international expansion.

- financials: Eligibility expressly requires at least 3 years operating record (2023–2025). A generic net-worth footnote permits new-company financial substitutes, but does NOT clearly waive the 3-year operating requirement; younger companies need clarification and must not assume eligibility.

- individual: Unregistered individual cannot meet enterprise/certificate requirements.

## Product and application requirements

- international_goal: At least one measurable overseas goal: physical exhibition, accelerator, fundraising, business development or overseas office; target country/market, actions/resources and acceptance indicators.

- application: Online business certificate, expansion proposal PDF ≤20MB, slides PDF ≤20MB, company/financial/compliance annexes.

- security: Software/AI security and prohibited-origin model rules apply; actual outputs and documented achievement assessed.

## Attendance and location

- selection: Company responsible person or delegated full-time employee must attend and present; absence forfeits eligibility. Up to 5 attendees, limited to company head/full-time staff. Remote option unspecified.

- execution: Participate in requested promotional/award activities, implementation checks and final review. At least chosen physical overseas activity where included in approved target.

- closeout: Results report within 1 week after completion; on-site execution and expense verification within 1 month under manual workflow.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Up to TWD1m each for approximately 15 enterprises, tied to verified international expansion outcomes and actual eligible costs. Not unrestricted cash prize.

- payment: After outcome and voucher verification; reduced for underachievement/ineligible expense. Taxes including applicable stamp/income tax payable.

- match: No fixed matching ratio found in this reward manual; do not import 50% subsidy rule from separate R&D grant.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: No payroll expense head in this reward; cannot claim ordinary founder salary.

- rent: Eligible event venue/equipment rental and event setup; ordinary home/office rent not established.

- travel: Approved overseas airfare and hotel for full-time project personnel, trip report and ticket/boarding/payment evidence; unrelated itinerary removed. Employee dorms/private house rental or imputed/depreciated owned housing excluded.

- computers: Capital expenditure excluded; full computer purchase not eligible.

- API_subscriptions: General API/SaaS subscriptions not established. Only approved items fitting marketing or commissioned-service categories may qualify.

- categories: Only innovation-service promotion, commissioned professional services and foreign travel. Overseas legal/tax/translation and marketing/event/advertising costs subject to approved purpose, duration allocation and invoices/payment proof.

- reporting_clawback: At least 3 years post-completion outcome cooperation. Goal changes generally requested 30 days before change; results and originals audited. False declarations/expenses, duplicate funding and breaches can revoke award/recover funds; full unrestricted IP/use rights not promised.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: 2026-07-14 by 16:59:59; system closes 17:00. Taiwan local UTC+8 is interpretation, not explicit timezone label.

- execution: From announcement through 2027-06-30. This is not a 2027 application call.

# Civic Action Hub 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 guidelines, 16 pages including public forms, inspected. Applications closed; delivery continues into March 2027.

Team minimum: 1 applicant permitted. Final team combines one assigned digital adviser and at least one creative participant.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- individual: Anyone with lawful Taiwan residence evidence, regardless of nationality/age/status; minors under 18 need written guardian consent. One person may join only one team.

- entity: Individuals/team applications; no incorporation needed. Company status does not replace personal eligibility.

- selection: 4 teams and 4 reserves around local disaster-governance topics in Nantou, Keelung, Miaoli and New Taipei.

## Product and application requirements

- proposal: Chinese editable Word/PPT/ODF with contents and page numbers. Problem analysis, solution/platform/location, roles, resources, delivery and impact. No application video or pre-existing MVP requirement found.

- outputs: Working/test platform, repeated user tests, security fixes, public code and final report/slides. Standard for Public Code compliance and licences required.

## Attendance and location

- pitch: August 25 physical Demo Pitch and government collaboration ceremony.

- programme: September meetings and government collaboration; milestone reviews and presentation/media participation. No blanket remote exemption.

- publication: Code to MODA GitHub by February 15 2027 and final report/slides March 1.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: TWD300,000 equivalent gift vouchers/rewards per selected team, NOT cash.

- instalments: 30%/30%/40% after three accepted checkpoints. Recipient bears taxes; nonresident withholding 20%.

- other_funding: No other funding provided; teams supply their own necessary software/hardware and resources.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Not a payroll reimbursement programme; vouchers cannot be represented as unrestricted cash salary.

- rent: No additional reimbursement.

- travel: No additional travel funding established.

- computers: Teams provide required hardware themselves; no separate equipment budget.

- API_subscriptions: Teams provide software/services themselves; no API reimbursement promise.

- IP: Open-source/public-code delivery and licence compliance, authors moral rights preserved; confidentiality/personal-data duties.

- reporting_clawback: No reward if agreed deliverables or required promotion not completed. Three checkpoints govern vouchers. Separate cooperation contract remains uninspected; confidentiality annex contains continuing duties and damages liability.

- confidentiality: Annex 3 continues secrecy after departure/end; return all owners data, no unauthorised destruction/retention. Do not exploit project confidential information for own/others business. Personal data only on agreed encrypted systems; no personal computer or other cloud without consent. Breach may cause joint damages liability.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: 2026-08-19 12:00 noon. Local Taiwan time inferred; separate timezone label not verified.

- milestones: Mid-September design; end-September contract/check 1; mid-October first code/test platform; end-November testing with ≥4 users and medium-or-higher security fixes; end-December final/check 2; mid-January security fixes; 2027-02-15 code; 2027-03-01 report/slides/check 3.

# Yawan AI Innovation Proof of Concept 2026

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

2026 official recruitment notice verified; linked application destination no longer exposes full annexes. Closed; no 2027 call established.

Team minimum: No numeric founder/team minimum published.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Taiwan SME startup founded after 2018-04-25; PRC-invested companies and Taiwan branches of foreign companies excluded.

- individual_soleprop: Requires eligible business/startup evidence; unregistered individuals not established eligible; sole-proprietor acceptance not resolved from notice.

- focus: AI/SaaS solutions for automotive electronics, plastics/rubber/chemicals, food and logistics; industrial PoC with southern Taiwan industry. Approximately 20 teams.

## Product and application requirements

- documents: Application form Annex 2, pitch Annex 3, company undertaking Annex 4 and personal-data consent Annex 5. Annex contents inaccessible at current linked destination.

- product: Industrial solution/PoC readiness assessed; exact MVP/traction threshold and video requirement not available.

## Attendance and location

- briefings: Physical April 14 or online April 15 information session listed; whether attendance mandatory not stated.

- selection: Online pitch in early May.

- programme: Southern Taiwan industrial fieldwork/PoC and networking/showcase; exact compulsory schedule, final location and remote exemptions unavailable.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Mentoring, industrial PoC/matching and possible platform/API resources from partners including Google/Microsoft. No fixed cash grant or quantified credit guarantee verified.

- equity: No verified investment/equity terms.

# FinTechSpace Batch 16

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

September 2026 Batch 16 international guidance and application/business-plan annexes inspected. Applications open through October 13; residency starts January 2027. Domestic links on webpage still show Batch 15 and must not silently replace current Batch 16 terms.

Team minimum: No numeric team minimum. Resident seats are for qualifying core team; seat caps are not minimum headcount.

Scope: include

## Eligibility

- entity: Registered domestic/international company, capital ≤TWD100m OR employees ≤200; registration proof in Mandarin/English. Domestic company also tax registration, foreign company exempt from that Taiwan tax proof.

- product: Fintech prototype and core innovation such as blockchain, AI, cybersecurity or virtual assets. Regulatory and cybersecurity checks before admission.

- individual_soleprop: Individual applicants do not meet registered-company requirement; sole-proprietor treatment not clear. No founder nationality exclusion stated for international route.

- scope: These are international-route Batch 16 terms; exact updated domestic package should be separately verified.

- integrity: Signed declaration covers company, team and managerial staff: specified convictions and lookback periods, bankruptcy, bill dishonour, unsettled serious credit loss, regulator removal and dishonest conduct. Full form must be checked individually; this is more than an ordinary pending-lawsuit question.

## Product and application requirements

- application: Form 1 and signed/sealed declarations, registration evidence, business proposal ≤15 A4 pages with page numbers. Optional sealed institutional recommendation. No public compulsory video found.

- checks: Financial regulatory and cybersecurity review required. Conditional bank/P2P self-assessment for relevant business.

- resident: Core team members use seats; physical residency and reporting obligations, not a passive grant.

## Attendance and location

- pitch: One day November 3–5; remote option not specified.

- fixed: Taipei, Nanhai Road No.1 floor 13; fixed-desk guideline includes 80% monthly actual attendance. Maximum 6 seats.

- hot: Hot-desk space subject to availability, maximum 10 seats; not evidence of guaranteed full remote participation.

- programme: Required regulatory/cyber review November 23–December 4, signing within 10 working days after acceptance steps; operational/fundraising progress reports.

## Award and commercial terms

- type: Paid subsidised workspace and accelerator services, NOT a cash award or promised investment.

- fixed_desk: 2027-01-01–12-31: NTD2,800/seat/month promotional rate versus 4,000 standard. First rent plus one-month deposit = NTD5,600/seat; monthly prepayment by 30th.

- hot_desk: 2027-01-01–06-30: NTD2,100/seat/month versus 3,000 standard; six-month prepay plus deposit = NTD14,700/seat.

- termination: Early departure generally requires 2 months notice or deposit forfeiture/continuing rent under terms. Fee/deposit commitment must be reviewed before signing.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: No funding for payroll established.

- rent: Participant pays discounted workspace, not a rent cash grant.

- travel: No travel reimbursement promised.

- computers: No cash equipment grant established.

- API_subscriptions: No quantified guaranteed credits in reviewed agreement.

- IP: Applicant owns IP subject to law/agreement and warrants originality; free promotional-use permission.

- reporting_clawback: Operating/fundraising reports, attendance, regulatory compliance and rent duties. False materials, violations or arrears may terminate admission; deposit/fees consequences apply.

## Dates and deadlines

- application: September 3–October 13 2026. Closing hour/timezone not stated in inspected international guide; do not assume end-of-day.

- selection: Eligibility October 20; pitch November 3–5; result November 13; checks November 23–December 4.

- payments_residency: Payment by December 31; January 1 2027 move-in; fixed 12 months, hot 6 months.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# U-start Innovation and Entrepreneurship Program

Checked 12 October 2026. Public-source diligence; no application or account was submitted.

## Edition and scope

Official ROC115/2026 programme package inspected. Publication December 2025 and cover November 2025 are preparation dates for 2026, not a historical 2025 call. Stage 2 runs into 2027.

Team minimum: At least 3 people; newly discovered exclusion under requested minimum-three-plus rule.

Scope: excluded_minimum_3_plus

## Eligibility

- team: At least 3; at least two-thirds, rounded up, Taiwan-national college students (including qualifying fourth-year junior-college students) or graduates in academic years 110–114 first semester. Other members generally ages 18–35, including qualifying foreign residents/visa holders.

- leader: Taiwan student/recent graduate, full time without outside job, at least 18 by funding; becomes prepared-business/company head.

- exclusions: Any member previously receiving U-start support excluded; members cannot be heads of other companies during application/award as defined in guide.

- application_route: Through participating university incubator, up to 15 projects/school; not an unaffiliated solo direct application.

## Product and application requirements

- application: School/team operating and mentoring plans, member eligibility proofs and consents, detailed budget. Incubation contract and business preparatory office/entity steps before funding.

- stage2: Only stage-1 winners may compete; continuation not automatic.

## Attendance and location

- programme: Stage 1 six months with at least 2 mentoring meetings monthly, school supervision and monthly original receipts. Stage-2 reviews/operations follow separate schedule.

- remote: No blanket fully remote entitlement; school incubation participation and review obligations.

## Award and commercial terms

- stage1: TWD500,000 total: TWD350,000 team business expenses and TWD150,000 school incubation support. Not TWD500,000 unrestricted founder cash.

- stage2: TWD350,000–1m for selected continuing teams, not automatic.

- match: Team self-funding required; universal numeric matching ratio not established from reviewed passages.

## Permissible spending and obligations

- founder_salary: Eligible team personnel costs capped at 70% of team subsidy, subject to documented duties and school handling; not arbitrary owner draw.

- rent: Approved business rent may qualify.

- travel: Approved domestic travel eligible; foreign travel excluded.

- computers: Durable equipment and hardware repairs excluded.

- API_subscriptions: Information-service costs appear in business expense categories; exact API subscription eligibility still requires approved budget.

- other: Registration/bookkeeping/materials/advertising may qualify; bonuses, entertainment/public-relations hospitality excluded. School grant covers incubation, no extra administration fee during six-month period; other charges by agreement.

- reporting_clawback: Monthly original receipts, school oversight, audits and return of unused funds; violations may recover funding. Full IP clauses not exhaustively transcribed because programme is excluded.

## Dates and deadlines

- stage1: 2026-02-25 17:00 deadline; May 1–October 31 2026 execution. Taiwan local-time interpretation.

- stage2: Separate August application for existing stage-1 teams; November 1 2026–October 31 2027 execution. Not an open 2027 solo call.

## Public application checklist

- Member roster — Required eligibility materials in 2026 package; no actual private data collected. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Names/birth dates/nationality/identity — Required eligibility materials in 2026 package; no actual private data collected. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Student or graduation evidence — Required eligibility materials in 2026 package; no actual private data collected. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Team roles/CVs — Required eligibility materials in 2026 package; no actual private data collected. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Consents — Required eligibility materials in 2026 package; no actual private data collected. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Operating plan — Required as applicable to application/award phase. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- School mentoring plan — Required as applicable to application/award phase. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Itemised business budget — Required as applicable to application/award phase. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- School recommendation/incubator application — Required as applicable to application/award phase. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Incubation agreement — Required as applicable to application/award phase. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

- Full per-cell form inventory — Not exhaustively transcribed after verified minimum-3 exclusion; official full package retained as source. ([source](https://ustart.yda.gov.tw/p/405-1000-2196,c145.php?Lang=zh-tw))

# AI FOR ALL Hackathon 2026

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:53:00Z

Edition: 2026; individual registration closed. Training and idea-submission stages follow.

Scope: Exclude from solo/duo shortlist: newly verified minimum 4. Retain record.

Team minimum: 4 at idea submission; team size 4–5. Initial registration is individual.

## Eligibility and legal form
- **applicant:** Thai citizens aged 18+; students, workers, entrepreneurs and other interested individuals. Company formation not required in public description.
- **residence:** No separate residence rule found.

## Application and product requirements
- **product:** AI idea addressing national challenges; training then prototype/MVP development. No prior AI experience required.
- **deck video:** Submission form closed; initial questions, deck/video format and upload limits inaccessible.
- **tracks:** Education, SME economy, agriculture/food, health/aging, mobility/cities, resilient communities; non-defense choices available.

## Attendance and location
- **registration:** Online
- **training:** October 1–30, 2026; delivery mode not explicitly verified.
- **idea submission:** Online October 1–November 4.
- **bootcamp:** Onsite Bangkok November 21–22.
- **final:** Onsite Bangkok December 12, 2026.

## Award and cost
- **type:** Cash prizes plus in-kind benefits
- **currency:** THB
- **first:** 250000
- **second:** 150000
- **third:** 100000
- **pool:** 500000
- **extras:** Certification vouchers; first-prize incubation opportunity and Echo or Kindle; second-prize Echo. No cash valuation or unconditional incubation commitment.

Scope: Exclude IDEA for team minimum ≥3; retain POC provisionally and retain combined record with branch distinction.

- **IDEA:** Thai students in Thai higher education or graduates within 5 years; ≥3 qualifying members and TED Fellow route.

Template additionally requires qualifying shareholder be an authorized signing director. National standing page says Thai ownership ≥51%; do not rely on exact boundary without current rules.

- **salary:** Not cash; cannot pay salaries.
- **rent:** Cannot pay physical rent.
- **travel:** Cannot pay travel.
- **computers:** Cannot buy computers.
- **subscriptions:** Most PostHog usage including analytics, replay, AI observability and context warehouse.

## Dates
- **application:** Rolling; age/funding limits apply.
- **expiration:** 12 months; no confirmed extension.

No reliably inspectable field inventory recovered. This is an access gap, not evidence that the application has no questions.

# Microsoft for Startups (current programme, historically Founders Hub)

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:53:00Z

Edition: Current public programme checked 12 October 2026; not a promise of future availability.

Scope: Provisionally include; team-size uncertainty is not exclusion.

Team minimum: Unknown; no minimum of 3+ established.

## Eligibility and legal form
- **applicant:** Early-stage B2B technology/software/AI startup, pre-seed–Series B, independent/private, eligible headquarters region. MVP in progress or existing.
- **incorporation:** Registered entity required for business verification/$5k milestone. Initial $200 route permits identity verification first; not proof of full sole-proprietor eligibility.

## Application and product requirements
- **verification:** Personal LinkedIn identity route; registered name/address must match legal documents. No public deck/video requirement.
- **advanced credits:** Workload milestones require sustained actual usage, not just activating services.

## Attendance and location
- **format:** Online; no mandatory event attendance established.

## Award and cost
- **type:** Azure service credits, not cash.
- **entry:** $200 non-referral route; $1,000 initial investor-code route per Oct9 application guide.
- **progression:** $5k verified legal business; $25k 5+ workloads, ~$60-day sustained period; $50k 7 workloads; $150k 10+ workloads plus ~$3k/month sustained Azure usage.
- **conditions:** Each qualifying workload ≥$1 spend throughout 60 consecutive days. Higher milestones may be direct; not sums to add together.
- **expiration:** At $25k milestone, one-time two-year extension. Initial expiry not established.

## Spending, reporting and legal conditions
- **salary:** Not cash; cannot pay salaries.
- **rent:** Cannot pay physical rent.
- **travel:** Cannot pay travel.
- **computers:** Cannot buy computers.
- **subscriptions:** Eligible Azure/AI/cloud services.
- **API:** Eligible Azure/AI/cloud services.
- **excluded spend:** Exact Marketplace/third-party-product exclusions not established in inspected pages; external subscriptions/APIs cannot be assumed covered.
- **reimbursements:** Service-billing credit, not cash reimbursement.
- **matching:** No cash match established except stated co-pay/overage rules.
- **reporting:** Unknown: not disclosed in the inspected public material; do not assume permission.
- **IP:** Unknown: not disclosed in the inspected public material; do not assume permission.
- **clawbacks:** Unknown: not disclosed in the inspected public material; do not assume permission.
- **overages:** Sponsorship automatically becomes pay-as-you-go when credits expire/exhaust; saved card can be charged.

## Dates
- **application:** Rolling; typical review 3 business days.

- Preferred contact email with verification code: Required on investor-code application path. [Evidence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/startups/microsoft-for-startups/application)

# AWS Activate

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:53:00Z

Edition: Current public programme checked 12 October 2026; not a promise of future availability.

Scope: Provisionally include; team-size uncertainty is not exclusion.

Team minimum: Unknown; no minimum of 3+ established.

## Eligibility and legal form
- **applicant:** Startup <10 years, pre-Series B, active company website, AWS Paid Tier account. Founders self-funded/new to credits; Portfolio provider-backed with valid Org ID and latest funding within 12 months where applicable.
- **excluded:** Government entities; previous credits of equal/higher amount for requested tier.
- **legal form:** No guaranteed individual/sole-proprietor acceptance established.

## Application and product requirements
- **deck video:** No mandatory deck/video exposed in public guide. Authenticated form branches inaccessible.

## Attendance and location
- **format:** Online; no physical attendance stated.

## Award and cost
- **Founders:** US$1,000 initially; selected applicants may reach US$5,000.
- **Portfolio:** Up to US$200,000, provider/package dependent.
- **AI:** Above $200k invite-only scaling support, not general entitlement.
- **renewals:** Approved higher offers generally give difference from prior credits, subject lifetime cap.
- **expiration:** Usually 1–2 years by package; exact Billing expiry controls.

## Spending, reporting and legal conditions
- **salary:** Not cash; cannot pay salaries.
- **rent:** Cannot pay physical rent.
- **travel:** Cannot pay travel.
- **computers:** Cannot buy computers.
- **subscriptions:** Eligible AWS services and some support, including third-party foundation models through Amazon Bedrock.
- **API:** Eligible AWS services and some support, including third-party foundation models through Amazon Bedrock.
- **excluded spend:** Marketplace excluded except Bedrock third-party model spend; Mechanical Turk, Managed Services, Professional Services, training/certification, Route53 domain registration/transfer, crypto mining, upfront Savings Plan/Reserved Instance fees and ineligible premium support; taxes excluded.
- **reimbursements:** Service-billing credit, not cash reimbursement.
- **matching:** No cash match established except stated co-pay/overage rules.
- **reporting:** Accurate compliance records and documentary evidence on request.
- **IP:** Publicity licence for submitted company marks/materials; no product-IP assignment established.
- **clawbacks:** Misused credits may be void and reimbursement demanded.
- **overages:** Ineligible usage, taxes and usage beyond credits billed; payment card needed. Support-credit exhaustion may leave billable support until downgraded.

## Dates
- **application:** Rolling; Portfolio within 12 months latest funding where applicable; guide 7–10 business-day review (landing 5–10).

## Public application fields
- AWS Builder ID and email verification: Required per public guide; funded-date conditional when applicable. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)

- Current traction: Required per public guide; funded-date conditional when applicable. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)
- Funding stage: Required per public guide; funded-date conditional when applicable. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)
- Latest funding date: Required per public guide; funded-date conditional when applicable. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)
- Company profile: Required per public guide; funded-date conditional when applicable. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)

- Activate Provider Org ID: Required Portfolio only; confidential provider code. [Evidence](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)

# Cloudflare for Startups

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:53:00Z

Edition: Current public programme checked 12 October 2026; not a promise of future availability.

Scope: Provisionally include; team-size uncertainty is not exclusion.

Team minimum: Unknown; no minimum of 3+ established.

## Eligibility and legal form
- **applicant:** For-profit technology startup incorporated ≤10 years; public website/social profile and matching business email; first acceptance; up to Series B; page says funding within 12 months.
- **tiers:** Bootstrapped/<$1m raised Tier3; affiliated partner plus <$5m Tier2; affiliated partner plus ≥$5m Tier1.
- **ambiguity:** General recent-funding criterion conflicts with bootstrapped tier; bootstrapped applicants need branch-specific verification.
- **excluded:** Existing Enterprise customers; education/personal blogs, consultancies/agencies/MSPs/resellers.

## Application and product requirements
- **form:** Apply Here link verified to 404; no reliable complete field inventory. Account/payment method required if accepted.

## Attendance and location
- **format:** Online; optional events/office hours.

## Award and cost
- **Tier3:** US$10,000 one year
- **Tier2:** US$100,000 one year
- **Tier1:** US$350,000 one year
- **expiry:** 12 months or consumed; no extensions. Upgrades discretionary and do not reset expiry.
- **equity:** No equity exchange advertised; service credits, not cash.

## Spending, reporting and legal conditions
- **salary:** Not cash; cannot pay salaries.
- **rent:** Cannot pay physical rent.
- **travel:** Cannot pay travel.
- **computers:** Cannot buy computers.
- **subscriptions:** Workers/platforms, Durable Objects, workflows, KV/D1/queues/vectorize, R2, images/stream and selected delivery; free security/network plan benefits separate.
- **API:** Workers/platforms, Durable Objects, workflows, KV/D1/queues/vectorize, R2, images/stream and selected delivery; free security/network plan benefits separate.
- **excluded spend:** AI Gateway, registrar purchase/renewal, enterprise add-ons by default, Magic Transit/Enterprise Spectrum/dedicated IP/China Network.
- **reimbursements:** Service-billing credit, not cash reimbursement.
- **matching:** No cash match established except stated co-pay/overage rules.
- **reporting:** Unknown: not disclosed in the inspected public material; do not assume permission.
- **IP:** Company-name/logo publicity licence.
- **clawbacks:** Provider may terminate/change programme; nontransferable/noncash credits. Taxes applicant responsibility.
- **caps:** R2 $10k; Workers AI Tier3 $2.5k, Tier2 $10k, Tier1 $50k.
- **overages:** Valid payment method required; overages/expiry billed. Enterprise domains may revert to Free if not transitioned; do not assume all consumption stops.

## Dates
- **application:** Rolling, advertised review up to 48h.
- **expiry:** One year from confirmation.

## Public application fields
No reliably inspectable field inventory recovered. This is an access gap, not evidence that the application has no questions.

## Unresolved and access limits
- Current official Apply Here target 404. No field list recovered. Public marketing says 100% SLA while terms say no SLA; treat SLA as unresolved contractual conflict.

## Official evidence
- [Cloudflare for Startups official programme page](https://www.cloudflare.com/startups/) — Current as inspected 2026-10-12; publication/update date not supplied
- [Current page Apply Here target returns 404](https://www.cloudflare.com/lp/startups) — Observed 2026-10-12; publication/update date not supplied

## Planning caution
No application, account creation or outreach was performed. Undisclosed conditions are not permission to spend. Headline credits, pools and investor access are not unrestricted cash. No future edition is assumed from a past edition.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# 2027 NIA Start-Up Challenge and Accelerator

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:52:00Z

Edition: Confirmed forthcoming 2027 call; actual initial submission form not published until 2026-12-01.

Scope: include; minimum team: 1.

## Eligibility

- Individual, group, or entity; participants at least 18 at submission. Individual prize recipients and team lead must be US citizens or permanent residents. Non-US people may participate on an otherwise eligible team but cannot receive any monetary share.

- Entity must be US-incorporated with US primary place of business. At participation, certify existing or intended US-owned/operated SBIR/STTR-eligible small business by 2027-11-01. Sole-proprietor treatment is not separately stated.

- Cannot be PI on an active NIH SBIR/STTR award at submission close, or previous NIA Start-Up Challenge finalist. Federal entities, HHS employees, official federal-employee participation, judges/organizers and specified immediate family excluded. Other federal employees need ethics review.

## Application field inventory

- Initial registration and submission: Required; complete field inventory unavailable before December 1 opening. No invented fields. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Team lead / entity point of contact: Conditional: team lead submits for team; entity contact submits for entity. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Innovation concept and benefit from support: Required substantive criteria: aging need, scientific basis, differentiation, commercialization, submitter expertise, need for training/resources, and at least two stated NIA impact pathways; these are judging requirements, not verified portal field labels. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- SBIR/STTR-eligible company and program-officer meeting: Stage 2 required by November 1, 2027. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Prize impact statement: Stage 2 required, one page. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Pitch video: Stage 2 required, 7 minutes; product significance/innovation/commercialization, team, delivery. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Mentor assessment: Stage 2 evaluation input. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- Verification and payment documents: Conditional winner requirement within 3 business days of notification; document names not published. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

- UEI/SAM registration: Optional for entities; encouraged to expedite payment. [Evidence](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator)

## Deliverables and requirements

- Science-driven aging/older-adult innovation including dementia, healthy aging, care delivery and caregiver burden; AI explicitly of interest. No initial mandatory MVP, customers or revenue threshold stated.

- Multiple submissions allowed, but only one finalist selection per individual/team/entity. Avoid all confidential/proprietary content: submission licenses NIH publication of all or parts.

- Training develops a 2-minute elevator pitch and 7-minute presentation. Stage 2 scoring: mentor/impact statement 45 points, video 55 points.

## Attendance

- Application: Online submission; screening call for leading candidates.

- Programme: Approximately five months June–November 2027, 6–8 hours/week, weekly virtual sessions and mentor meetings.

- In person: Three-day bootcamp June 2027 and three-day innovation/investment conference November 2027. Strongly encouraged; comparable training/conference alternative requires advance approval. Registration paid; participant pays travel.

- Final: 7-minute submitted video; no separate final-stage travel obligation stated.

## Award and payment

- Type: Cash prizes plus no-cost accelerator; not described as equity investment.

- Stage 1: Up to 21 finalists × USD 24,000; disbursed within three months of accelerator start.

- Stage 2: Up to 7 selected finalists × USD 70,000; selected January 2028.

- Total pool: Up to USD 994,000; a Stage 2 winner can receive USD 94,000 across stages.

- Payment: Electronic funds transfer; taxes/withholding possible. Team lead receives team prize; entity receives entity prize directly. NIH may cancel/modify or withhold unworthy prizes.

## Expenditure and obligations

- Salary: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Rent: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Travel: A portion of Stage 1 cash may explicitly support in-person attendance travel.

- Flights: Travel-related expenses permitted in principle; flights are not separately enumerated.

- Computers: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Subscriptions: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Api credits: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Matching: No matching requirement stated.

- Reimbursement: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Reporting: Stage 2 deliverables and mentor assessment; separate financial reporting not published.

- Clawback: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Notes: Stage 1 supports early business/product development. Stage 2 impact examples include team expansion, pilot data, customers and fundraising, but examples are not itemized allowable-cost guarantees.

- Federal funds: Federal grants/cooperative funds only where consistent with original award, with entry on behalf of awardee entity; prize becomes program income. Federal contract funds prohibited for submission/support.

- Ip: Publication permission for submission; ownership transfer not stated. No confidential/proprietary materials.

## Dates

- Submission opens 2026-12-01; closes 2027-01-15 at 11:59 PM ET (2027-01-16 04:59 UTC).

- Webinar 2026-12-03 1 PM ET; Stage 1 finalists May 2027; accelerator June–November 2027.

- Company/NIH program officer milestones 2027-11-01; final submission/pitch November 2027 exact day unpublished; Stage 2 winners January 2028.

## Gaps and cautions

- Initial application fields/word limits/attachments not yet released.

- Specific in-person venues and exact final submission deadline; Stage 2 payment schedule; itemized expense/reporting/clawback terms not stated.

- NIA companion page currently presents JavaScript verification; NIH full announcement read successfully.

## Primary sources

- [NIH 2027 NIA Start-Up Challenge and Accelerator: full announcement/rules](https://www.nih.gov/challenges/2027-nia-start-challenge-accelerator) — 2027; date: 2026-09-23

## Planning distinction
Only explicit current requirements above are application instructions. Historical details and estimates are planning references; unknown costs are not deemed allowable. No accounts were created, applications submitted, or organizers contacted.

# MIT $50K Vietnam Entrepreneurship Competition 2026–2027

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:52:00Z

Edition: Live 2026 application round for March 2027 final.

Scope: include; minimum team: 1.

## Eligibility

- Solo or unlimited-size team; lead must be currently enrolled master’s, PhD or postdoctoral student in good standing at accredited Vietnamese university (full/part time). International students eligible.

- All other members affiliated with same institution. Faculty, staff and researchers can be members, not leads; faculty/staff cannot receive prize money. Undergraduates excluded from every role.

- One idea per team, one application per person. Original pre-commercial idea; prototypes/pilots allowed, commercial launch disqualifies. No external funding of any kind for idea (including grants/prizes/donations/loans/equity); own-resource bootstrapping allowed. Disclose funding received after first deadline.

- No company formation requirement; payout can go to registered business only with all members’ written forfeiture of individual shares. Sole-proprietor payout not expressly addressed.

## Application field inventory

- Structured application: Required; individual labels and required/optional branches behind Reviewr account, not publicly exposed. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

- Written pitch document: Required, maximum 2 pages; excess truncated. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

- Video link: Required, 90-second pitch; excess truncated. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

- Eligibility and rights representations: Required by submission; institutional affiliation and original idea rights. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

- Later external funding disclosure: Conditional required when received after round-one deadline. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

- Entity prize allocation agreement: Conditional: all members must agree in writing to forfeit individual shares to registered entity. [Evidence](https://www.mit50kvn.org.vn/rules.php?lang=en)

## Deliverables and requirements

- English or Vietnamese application, without organizer translation. Five finalists present in English. Technology-driven innovation, for-profit viability, social impact and execution readiness assessed.

- Final submission cannot be amended or resubmitted. Applicants retain IP; evaluation material restricted to organizers/judges. Avoid highly sensitive proprietary disclosure. No mandatory working MVP or existing traction; commercial operation is actually disqualifying.

## Attendance

- Application: Digital submission.

- Interview: No interview requirement published.

- Final: Mandatory in-person final; finalists must present in English. Location, pitch timing and which/all team members must attend not specified in accessible rules.

- Travel: No explicit airfare/hotel support.

## Award and payment

- Type: Non-dilutive cash prizes.

- Amount: First USD-equivalent 30,000; second 15,000; third 5,000. Paid in VND; conversion rate confirmed nearer final.

- Payment: Team allocates among eligible recipients; recipients handle taxes. Payment timing not given.

- Equity: None; homepage expressly says non-dilutive.

# PIDI Digdaya x Hackathon 2026

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:52:00Z

Edition: 2026 competition concluded per published September timeline; 2027 call not found.

Scope: include; minimum team: 1.

## Eligibility

- OJK programme FAQ expressly allows Indonesian citizens, 1–4 people, personal/company/university/institution/community entry; cross-institution teams allowed, one team per person. BI current FAQ says maximum 5, so max conflicts; minimum 1 supported.

- Student category: every member active diploma/S1/S2 student, domestic or overseas university, evidenced by student card or active-enrolment letter. Professional category includes founders/industry/lecturers/researchers/civil servants/freelancers/professionals.

- No company incorporation requirement published. No registration fee. Specific minimum age and resident requirement not published. Do not import foreign-member exceptions from separate 2025 OJK-Ekraf competition.

## Application field inventory

- Name: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- 16-digit KTP/NIK identity number: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Email and email OTP verification: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Phone number: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Password at least 8 characters: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Password confirmation: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Accuracy declaration: Required at account-registration stage [Evidence](https://hackathon.pidi.id/register)

- Personal and team data: Required after account registration; detailed profile fields not publicly accessible. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Team name: Required; one or two words describing solution, compliant with norms/no third-party brand or political/SARA references. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Idea proposal: Required using provided template; template questions not publicly accessible. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Student card / active-enrolment proof: Conditional student category. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Industry and PIDI certification: Semifinal/final condition: at least one provided industry certification and PIDI exam >=70%. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Working prototype and pitch: Required at Capstone/final quarantine/judging; prototype not necessarily required for first-round idea proposal. [Evidence](https://infinityhackathon.id/program/BI-OJK-2026)

- Second-stage proposal: Required by June 4, 2026. [Evidence](https://www.pidi.id/)

- Video: Required during practitioner stage by July 26, 2026; exact length/format unknown. [Evidence](https://www.pidi.id/)

## Deliverables and requirements

- Digital solutions in finance resilience/innovation; productivity/food/jobs; public service/creative/digital export. AI/ML or blockchain-connected technologies permitted. Proposal can span problem statements; assessed for relevance.

- IP remains with participants subject to detailed intellectual-property clause VI (not recovered). Technical judging includes relevance, novelty, quality and effectiveness/impact.

- Booklet plans 22 weeks/180 learning hours, progressive essential/practitioner/capstone certification; produces functional prototype and pitch deck.

## Attendance

- Application: Online registration/proposal.

- Programme: Hybrid; booklet names LPPI Kemang for offline activity. Essential self-paced online; practitioner includes face-to-face plus online.

- Final: Capstone prototype, quarantine and judging/pitch. Revised BI schedule gives Sept 21–25 quarantine/final judging and Sept 26 FEKDI showcase/awards. No verified fully remote alternative or travel reimbursement.

## Award and payment

- Type: Cash prize pool plus training/certification, job fair and business matching; potential venture-capital collaboration is not guaranteed investment.

- Pool: IDR 1,400,000,000 total advertised; individual place amounts/payment schedule not exposed in reviewed primary sources.

- Equity: No equity transfer condition published; IP retained.

- Fees: OJK FAQ says no registration or other participant fees.

## Expenditure and obligations

- Salary: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Rent: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Travel: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Notes: Cash versus any structured development support not itemized by winner; do not assume costs funded in advance. No travel, laptop, API or subscription reimbursement promise.

## Dates

- Revised main site submission closes 2026-04-05, replacing older March 27 dates; no time/timezone published.

- Second proposal June 4; semifinal June 19; video July 26; finalists Aug 6; capstone Aug 7–Sept 19 (revised Expo site).

- Quarantine/judging Sept 21–25; winner/showcase Sept 26. Initial February booklet and OJK page contain superseded dates.

## Gaps and cautions
