# Startup in Shanghai International Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition 2026

Checked: 2026-10-12T05:52:00Z

Edition: Confirmed 2026 call, regional deadline passed; finals scheduled October. Excluded after current official form establishes minimum 3.

Scope: exclude_minimum_team_3_plus_retain_record; minimum team: 3.

## Eligibility

- OFFICIAL FORM requires >=3 core members for team AND enterprise forms. Validation prohibits proceeding/removing below 3. Team first member is top-ranked core member; enterprise first member founder/actual controller.

- Team route includes unincorporated teams, non-Shanghai enterprises with concrete Shanghai setup plan, or Shanghai companies younger than one year at launch.

- Startup companies: nonlisted Shanghai registration Jan 1 2023–Dec 31 2025, previous-year revenue <=CNY30m. Growth: Jan 1 2018–Dec 31 2025, revenue <=CNY200m. High-tech innovative R&D/products/services and uncontested/independent IP.

- Overseas participation allowed; no nationality/residency exclusion stated in announcement. Sole proprietor is not expressly supported. Special tracks have their own conditions.

## Application field inventory

- Project name: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Team name: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Primary industry: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Innovation field: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- IP yes/no: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Technology keywords: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Technology/product/service description: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Service needs (1–3 selections): Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- At least 3 members: name, gender, birthdate, highest education, overseas study, entrepreneurship count, identity type/number, Fortune-500 experience, mobile, biography: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Signed commitment template: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Top-ranked member identity/passport scan: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Business plan: Required for team application, verified public form validation [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Secondary industry / solicitation direction / subfield: Conditional by selected industry/embodied-intelligence track. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- IP title/number records: Conditional when IP claimed. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Location/area/price preferences: Conditional on premises service need. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Expected funding and equity percentage: Conditional financing-service request; >0 funding, >0–100% equity; this is desired investment, not grant equity surrender. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Other service text: Conditional on Other. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Other supporting evidence/honors: Optional PDF, each <=5MB; describe type in filename. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Enterprise basic information: Required enterprise route: entity/type/credit code/date/registered and office addresses, head/contact names/mobile/email, introduction/publication choice/keywords/district/parks/incubator statuses, tech-service/high-tech flags, employee/R&D/fresh-graduate/international-talent and education counts, listed-company control. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Enterprise finance and IP: Equity/debt status with conditional investor/lender/round/date/amount; recent financial figures, patent/software/layout/drug/device counts; dynamic requirements by group/year. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Enterprise project narratives: Required technology/product 2000 characters; market/competition 2000; business model 1000; five-year development plan 1000; keywords maximum five, each <=10 characters. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Enterprise core members: At least 3; team fields plus political status, full-time, role and founder status. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

- Enterprise attachments: Required signed/stamped commitment, business licence and last two years stamped balance sheet/profit/cashflow PDF; each <=5MB. Investment-fast-track documents conditional. Other qualifications/honors optional. [Evidence](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js)

## Deliverables and requirements

- Select regional group/track; identity verification and truthful complete material. One specialized track maximum, alongside regional competition.

- Investment fast track: >=CNY50m equity from registered investment institution from 2024 through registration, verified. No universal MVP/traction minimum, but high-tech project/rights and business evidence required.

## Attendance

- Application: Online via official platform; complete fields recovered from public application assets without login/submission.

- Competition: Enterprise quarterfinals, all-category semifinals and finals: onsite eight-minute presentation plus seven-minute Q&A.

- Travel: No airfare/accommodation funding commitment found.

## Award and payment

- Cash: Fund regulation specifies CNY200,000 / 600,000 / 800,000 / 1,000,000 depending award level; precise level mapping not in reviewed rule text. Not automatic for every winner.

- Team condition: Funding eligibility retained two years; must incorporate Shanghai enterprise with top-ranked member as actual controller AND receive >=CNY5m angel investment in place.

- General fund conditions: Nonlisted Shanghai SME, prior-year revenue <=CNY200m, R&D >=CNY500k and >=5% revenue, <=500 staff with R&D >=10%; good standing, fewer than three prior innovation grants. One supported project/year. Applicability to newly formed team companies needs implementing guidance.

- In kind: Team finalists up to six months rent-free office/workstation; team semifinalists three months workstation; specialized team winners three months. Finance matchmaking/loans/vouchers are additional opportunities, not guaranteed cash.

- Equity: Grant not stated as equity purchase; required external angel financing is separately dilutive on negotiated terms.

## Expenditure and obligations

- Salary: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Rent: In-kind free space at qualifying levels; not unrestricted rent reimbursement.

- Travel: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Flights: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Computers: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Subscriptions: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Api credits: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Matching: Team payout requires >=CNY5m received angel investment; not described as simple 1:1 match.

- Reimbursement: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Reporting: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Clawback: Not specified in accessible edition-specific rules; do not assume permitted or reimbursable.

- Notes: Innovation fund rules require dedicated use and oversight; district tracking, audits/random/site checks. Violations/research dishonesty subject to financial/scientific-integrity rules and legal sanctions. Exact eligible cost schedule, tranches, reimbursement and clawback formula not provided.

## Dates

- Regional applications 2026-05-31, exact time/timezone unpublished; eligibility review June 15.

- Preliminaries by July; quarters August; semis September; final October 2026. Specialized calls separately announced.

## Gaps and cautions

- Excluded from solo/two-person target regardless other attractiveness. Public form assets are current and could evolve; no private form submitted.

- Category-specific exact grant mapping, expense schedule and newly formed enterprise fund eligibility reconciliation.

- Full specialised-track schemas not audited after universal regional minimum exclusion.

## Primary sources

- [Shanghai government 2026 competition announcement](https://english.shanghai.gov.cn/en-Latest-TalentsinShanghai/20260403/3859e68d8a914d2bbbe259f63b8c188c.html) — 2026; date: 2026-04-03

- [Public official form component: validation and visible labels](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/TabOverview-bor3hqcZ.js) — Current website served 2026-10-12; date: not published/checked current

- [Public official application workflow component](https://www.startup-sh.cn/cyds/assets/ApplyPage-BlmtstgN.js) — Current website served 2026-10-12; date: not published/checked current

- [Shanghai Sci-Tech SME Innovation Fund rules, Hu Ke Gui [2025] 7](https://kjgl.stcsm.sh.gov.cn/wdcms/kjzc/1169.jhtml) — Effective 2025-12-09–2030-12-08; date: 2025-12-02

## Planning distinction
Only explicit current requirements above are application instructions. Historical details and estimates are planning references; unknown costs are not deemed allowable. No accounts were created, applications submitted, or organizers contacted.

# DOST-PCAARRD Startup Grant Fund 2026

One company or responsible person/year; at most two grants within three years; unfinished city subsidy projects excluded. One-company route; joint route needs two companies, not two people. Software use/IP licences can qualify as R&D costs; office equipment and VAT excluded.

Confirm the applicable basis before budgeting. National map displayed May 19 as deadline; actual current city documents establish it as opening date and June 22 as cutoff. raw_findings.note_markdown:
# FITI — From IP to IPO Innovation and Entrepreneurship Incentive Program

Academic technology commercialisation training and awards; 2026 second intake closed, next intake unannounced.

## 1. Problem and deliverable

Potentially strong academic spinout funding and mentoring. Two founders could meet people count, but the affiliation/recommendation and TWD500k capital gate matter. Distinct from U-start despite formal referral linkage.

## 2. Eligibility and people

At least 50% of team must be students, graduates within one year, or full-time researchers affiliated with institutions eligible for NSTC research funding. An affiliated full-time assistant professor or above must recommend. No independent age/gender/citizenship/residence restriction found; foreign-recipient forms exist, but do not prove every foreign applicant qualifies. Company not required initially; established companies >one year must disclose and distinguish project from existing products. Rules recommend 2–5 at registration and expressly require 2–5 participating members during selection; do not label the latter merely optional.

## 3. Application fields and files

Public templates: field/team/project names; member name, DOB, institution/title, phone/email; recommending professor and institution-office contact; affiliation, prior FITI/company participation and related-member disclosures. Upload signed application/undertaking/consents, business plan Word/PDF, slides PPT/PDF; recommended plan covers technology/TRL progress, market/buyer evidence, pain points, finances and team. Optional public 1–3-minute video. Current application account not entered.

## 4. Work and originality requirements

Original innovative technology or health application tied to academic research; no same core work previously in FITI top 20. Prototype/business-model completeness evaluated later, not a universal mature-MVP entry rule.

## 5. Attendance

Approximately six months; technology owner attends major opening, camps, demonstrations/matching, reviews and awards with 2–5 participating members. Absence can cancel participation or incentives. Operational and career follow-up and free publicity licence required.

## 6. Awards and fees

Public-entry initial selection TWD10,000, then additional TWD50,000 and TWD200,000 by stages; referral entrants do not get initial TWD10,000. Outstanding award adds TWD1,000,000 company fund, not equity investment. Training free; award places separately determined per batch. Fee status: unknown. Training is explicitly free; a separate entry-fee statement was not established.

## 7. Expenses and IP

Implementation grants distributed to members per signed ratio/receipts, with tax withholding; apply within five working days of stage results. Million-dollar fund paid only to Taiwan company with qualifying registration dates and core project technology; apply within one year. Requires team governance/beneficiary relationship, business/finance plan, bank/tax/register documents and statutory capital audit proving team investment >=TWD500,000 into company capital increase. No fixed payment date; financial-year schedule applies. Funds support startup costs; no blanket receipt-free guarantee beyond published procedures.

## 8. Dates and chronology

2026-06-24; timezone not verified. Second batch intake closed. June 24 noon appears in university circulation, but clock not established in directly read organizer announcement; left null. Organizer states launch March 2013.

## 9. Evidence gaps

No next edition verified. Current 2026-2 download package uses rules revised May 15, 2025; illustrative forms retain older FITI2024 codes. Team investment is a company-fund condition, not an entry fee or state equity purchase. No complete public authenticated application view. Detailed travel reimbursement not established.

raw_findings.foreign_targeting: MOFA explicitly recruits foreign experts/scholars from overseas institutions to conduct research in Taiwan. APEC openings are one population allocation within this family, not another programme.
application_fields: Online application plus CV/publication list, principally three-page research proposal and two recommendations or recommendation plus chief-administrator consent. Documents also go to Taiwan mission in/near country of residence for preliminary review. Selected candidates then obtain Taiwan academic host consent; July 1, 2026 notice says wait until candidates announced. Detailed live fields unavailable in closed portal; no account/data submitted.
eligibility: Foreign overseas professors, associate/assistant professors, postdocs, doctoral candidates/students and equivalent research fellows. Mission-recommended candidates on Taiwan foreign/cross-strait relations also listed. Social sciences/humanities topic tied to Taiwan, cross-strait/mainland China, Asia-Pacific or Sinology required. Currently researching, teaching or studying in Taiwan excluded. No explicit numerical age/gender restriction found; nationality/residence and academic affiliation substantive. No startup company needed.
raw_findings.requirements: Deliverable is advanced research, not product MVP or pitch. Own Taiwan host/research arrangements. Topic/period changes need programme approval; no required application video identified.
raw_findings.attendance: Research physically in Taiwan for 3–12 months; programme seminars/relevant events required. Research findings >=20 pages within three months of completion; acknowledge fellowship. Leave >14 days in one month suspends that month's stipend. Paid employment requires MOFA consent; limited paid teaching exception appears in agreement.

award.terms: Monthly TWD 60,000 senior academic/research ranks or TWD 50,000 other eligible ranks. Paid at beginning of month. Direct economy round-trip reimbursed against ticket/payment evidence; regional caps: Northeast/Southeast Asia TWD 35 k, Europe/West Asia 60 k, North America 55 k, Central/South America 75 k, Africa 90 k, Oceania 65 k. Accident death TWD 1 m, accident-injury medical TWD 50 k per detailed rules; general introduction's insurance summary less precise.
award.equity: No organizer equity-purchase requirement identified in these programme sources.

raw_findings.expense_rules: Applicant bears excess costs, dependant support and broader health cover. # MOFA Taiwan Fellowship

Explicit foreign-researcher funded Taiwan residency. Official application page announces 2028 fellowship intake May 1–June 30, 2027; 2027 award selection intake already closed. Social-science/humanities research, not a general startup relocation grant.

## 1. Foreign recruitment and value

MOFA explicitly recruits foreign experts/scholars from overseas institutions to conduct research in Taiwan. APEC openings are one population allocation within this family, not another programme. Useful funded inbound research for qualified foreign professionals. Low direct relevance to routine SaaS building unless a qualifying Taiwan social-science research agenda exists; do not treat the stipend as unrestricted business income.

## 2. Eligibility and people

Individual application/recipient route; no team formation requirement identified. Foreign overseas professors, associate/assistant professors, postdocs, doctoral candidates/students and equivalent research fellows. Mission-recommended candidates on Taiwan foreign/cross-strait relations also listed. Social sciences/humanities topic tied to Taiwan, cross-strait/mainland China, Asia-Pacific or Sinology required. Currently researching, teaching or studying in Taiwan excluded. No explicit numerical age/gender restriction found; nationality/residence and academic affiliation substantive. No startup company needed.

## 3. Public application fields and files

Online application plus CV/publication list, principally three-page research proposal and two recommendations or recommendation plus chief-administrator consent. Documents also go to Taiwan mission in/near country of residence for preliminary review. Selected candidates then obtain Taiwan academic host consent; July 1, 2026 notice says wait until candidates announced. Detailed live fields unavailable in closed portal; no account/data submitted.

## 4. Actual deliverable

Deliverable is advanced research, not product MVP or pitch. Own Taiwan host/research arrangements. Topic/period changes need programme approval; no required application video identified.

## 5. Taiwan attendance

Research physically in Taiwan for 3–12 months; programme seminars/relevant events required. Research findings >=20 pages within three months of completion; acknowledge fellowship. Leave >14 days in one month suspends that month's stipend. Paid employment requires MOFA consent; limited paid teaching exception appears in agreement.

## 6. Benefits and fees

Monthly TWD 60,000 senior academic/research ranks or TWD 50,000 other eligible ranks. Paid at beginning of month. Direct economy round-trip reimbursed against ticket/payment evidence; regional caps: Northeast/Southeast Asia TWD 35 k, Europe/West Asia 60 k, North America 55 k, Central/South America 75 k, Africa 90 k, Oceania 65 k. Accident death TWD 1 m, accident-injury medical TWD 50 k per detailed rules; general introduction's insurance summary less precise. Application fee status: unknown.

## 7. Expenses and IP

Applicant bears excess costs, dependant support and broader health cover. Programme guidelines state visa fees waived; this is a reported benefit, not personal immigration advice. Concurrent Taiwan government/academic scholarships restricted. No equity or matching capital provision identified; separate entry-fee statement not found. Research report/acknowledgment required; IP transfer terms not established.

## 8. Edition and dates

2028 application's May 1–June 30, 2027 dates appear on current application page. Current introduction still describes 2027 application May–June 2026; distinct editions preserved. Deadline clock/timezone not stated.

## 9. Remaining gaps

Academic/topic/residence restrictions make ordinary software-founder eligibility unproven; owner not assessed. No detailed public live application form or definitive 2028 benefit amendment; award amounts are currently published standing rules, not a promise all 2028 terms unchanged. Insurance covers accidents, not comprehensive family medical support; IP and separate entry fee unresolved.

# TaiwanICDF Professional Workshops — International Human Resource Training Fellowship

Explicit inbound professional training for allied/friendly developing partner countries; funded travel/room/meals and TWD 700/day. Invitation through Taiwan overseas missions required; one workshop family, not thirteen programme additions.

## 1. Foreign recruitment and value

Organizer surveys overseas missions for partner-country training needs, focusing on foreign government officials and NGO professionals. Selected course also admits relevant industry/executive representatives, not all foreign founders. Substantial funded inbound professional exchange for suitable nominated foreign specialists, but short training with return-home/no-business duties limits founder relocation value. Keeping one family avoids padding courses.

## 2. Eligibility and people

Individual application/recipient route; no team formation requirement identified. Developing allied/friendly country professionals through embassy/representative-office/technical-mission invitation. General focus mid/senior government and NGO personnel; 2026 SME course permits trade/investment/smart-park representatives, AI-health course permits relevant executives with >=two years work. English proficiency required. Exact country list and individual age/gender/student restrictions not established; no Taiwan company setup required.

## 3. Public application fields and files

Completed application through Taiwan overseas mission; signed invitation/acceptance returned via mission. Current blank application form/individual field list not retrieved. Public terms require valid passport/travel document and course participant report/evaluation. No account, completed form or communications. No mandatory product, MVP or application pitch/video identified.

## 4. Actual deliverable

Professional short-course learning, site visits and reports in Taiwan. Civilian software relevance demonstrated by AI-health/data/telemedicine and digital-governance themes. Course-specific professional background matters; a tech company alone is insufficient.

## 5. Taiwan attendance

Punctual full course attendance; >=three unapproved absence days and poor participation can end fellowship. 2026 programme contains thirteen courses; smart-health II November 4–13 (entry closedSep 7), SME/smartparks June 2–11 (entry closedMay 4). Return home expected; no accompanying family/friends/pets or employment/business activity during course.

## 6. Benefits and fees

Selected participants' registration, direct economy airfare, arranged room, breakfast/lunch, insurance and TWD 700/day allowance covered. In-kind support, not startup capital or equity. Insurance excludes chronic illness. Unavoidable stopover accommodation against receipts <=USD 150/night, <=USD 450/round trip; arranged stay up to three unavoidable delay days. Application fee status: none.

## 7. Expenses and IP

Passport/vaccination/visa fees, personal room extras, additional itinerary/stay changes and excess costs applicant/employer responsibility. Poor attendance/misconduct may require full repayment including flight, room and allowances. No unrestricted business-spending award; exact allowance remittance dates not verified.

## 8. Edition and dates

Programme schedule active 2026, but actual read example intake deadlines May 4 andSep 7 closed. No family-wide next application date verified; workshop dates not used as application deadlines.

## 9. Remaining gaps

Invitation and partner-country/course-specific professional restrictions; owner qualification unknown. Blank application and exact target-country list unavailable in read sources. Remaining course-specific rule packages not individually audited; no claim every course fits software. No explicit IP allocation for participant output or allowance payment schedule; confirm if later applying.

# NSTC International Internship Pilot Program (IIPP)

Explicit foreign-talent recruitment into Taiwan research and future careers. Student-only overseas-enrolment route with TWD 1,000/day, not an employed-founder relocation fellowship. All 2026 entry/matching deadlines closed.

## 1. Foreign recruitment and value

NSTC expressly attracts global foreign student talent to Taiwan research, hoping subsequent study/career connections. Different family from TIIP, TEEP or student startup contests; no speculative benefit imported from them. Real cash-supported inbound research/career pathway for enrolled foreign technical talent; useful conditional on academic status. Significant self-financing and host IP obligations reduce direct solo-founder value.

## 2. Eligibility and people

Individual application/recipient route; no team formation requirement identified. Foreign bachelor/master/PhD students enrolled at overseas university through completion. Mainland China/Hong Kong/Macau nationality OR studying in those regions excluded. No age limit per FAQ; gender restriction not stated. Only once per person; withdrawal/negative record may exclude. Taiwan priority research fields and humanities/social sciences admitted. No business/entity requirement; professional founder without current qualifying enrolment not covered.

## 3. Public application fields and files

Account/profile required, not created. Public how-to: 360×480 headshot, enrolment certificate, recommendation, CV English/Chinese <=twoA4 pages/version, one-minute introduction video for language proof; FAQ also passport/temporary ID. Public privacy notice lists name/nationality/gender/DOB/contact/address/passport/school/department; privacy categories are not proof each live field mandatory.

## 4. Actual deliverable

Individual matched Taiwan academic/research placement 28–90 consecutive days; beginsJune–December 2026 and may run toFebruary 2027. Match completed and PI consent uploaded by applicable deadline, then secondary review/admission/declarations. No business pitch/MVP. PI advisory fee belongs to host PI, not intern benefit.

## 5. Taiwan attendance

Onsite research, confidentiality and institution rules; monthly reports/attendance gate subsequent stipend. Monthly reports 21 st in first/second months; final five days before end perFAQ; oral presentation if required. Host/PI change needs approval. Overseas follow-up encouraged.

## 6. Benefits and fees

TWD 1,000/day for 28–90 days, maximum TWD 90,000 individual allowance. Host institution pays monthly; first payment within 30 working days, no advance. No overlapping Taiwan government funding. Programme cap 600 interns is cohort quota, not team maximum. Application fee status: unknown.

## 7. Expenses and IP

Intern pays airfare, visa, room/living costs, insurance, utilities and host facility/internship fees. Thus not fully-funded travel. Entryfee separately unverified; possible hostcharges cannot be ignored. Violations can reduce/recover allowance. IP follows supervisor's institution, clarify beforehand; no applicant-owned IP assumption.

## 8. Edition and dates

2026 entry/matching deadlinesFebruary 13,April 15,July 15 per current FAQ; clocks/timezones unstated. Research may continueFebruary 2027 but not a new 2027 intake. Old 2025 rules retained above updated 2026 section; used currentdatedsection andFAQ.

## 9. Remaining gaps

Foreign-student only, not ordinary foreign-worker/founder programme; owner eligibility unknown. Legacy iipp.tw failed; verified currentNIARdomain. Publicpage mixes prior-year and currentrules; 2025 rolling/September 15 deadline discarded. Authenticated form not inspected. # Hangzhou Maker World Overseas Talent Entrepreneurship Competition

Foreign-targeted Hangzhou startup competition with AI software routes, cash prizes and conditional local business grants. Concept products are allowed.

## 1. Foreign recruitment and value

Official eligibility explicitly includes “非华裔外国人” (non-ethnic Chinese foreign nationals). Strong conditional civilian AI/software founder value; substantial qualification and landing obligations.

## 2. Eligibility and people

Overseas master's or higher, overseas innovation/entrepreneurship experience, born after January 1, 1976; return/arrival after January 1, 2022 if already in China. Earlier Hangzhou shareholding, legal-representative roles or social insurance and two previous entries exclude the applicant. No gender-based restriction found in the inspected public rules. Exact nationality, admission/host and age requirements are edition-specific as described above; no owner eligibility inferred. Individual applicant/recipient route published.

## 3. Application fields and files

Online registration and business-plan PPT/supporting files: technology, team, business model, strategy and funding. Public signed-in field layout not inspected.

## 4. Deliverable

Principal project owner personally presents. Legal IP or authorized use; one project/track. Up to three nominated core members; whole-team maximum ambiguous.

## 5. China attendance

Online semifinal, required matchmaking event, Hangzhou in-person finals. Absence at any stage withdraws entry.

## 6. Benefits and fees

Main-track 2026 cash RMB 200,000/100,000/50,000; main-final RMB 20,000; semifinal/new-sprout RMB 10,000, noncumulative. These amounts are not verified foreign special-track cash awards. Conditional landing grants RMB 200,000–5 million require Hangzhou entity registration and disbursement approval; foreign special-track benefit schedule remains unverified. Fee status: none.

## 7. Expenses and IP

No participation fee. False information/IP violations can recover prizes. No general participation-cost compensation promised; materials shared with partners and roadshows may be public. Grant matching and restricted-use details not verified.

## 8. Edition and dates

2026 rules published; intake deadline not verified. Deadline, grant disbursement contract, tax and travel coverage unverified. Foreign special-track award schedule separate; do not reuse main-track prizes as its direct promise.

raw_findings.note_markdown:
# Shanghai Magnolia Talent Pujiang Programme

Restricted overseas-returnee/foreign-naturalized talent funding for Shanghai research and enterprise innovation/startups. Distinct from Startup in Shanghai competition.

## 1. Foreign recruitment and value

Official 2024 government guide expressly includes “入外籍留学人员” (overseas students who acquired foreign nationality), not evidence all foreign nationals qualify. Useful conditional foreign-naturalized technical-founder/host grant; substantially narrower than foreign citizenship alone.

## 2. Eligibility and people

Foreign-naturalized overseas-study route confirmed in 2024. Local registered host, under/at published 45-year boundary, recent return/arrival, full-time Shanghai work. Individual route or team of at least three. Startup standing rules bachelor's, one overseas-study year, first-largest shareholder or legal representative with >=30% personal equity. No gender-based restriction found in the inspected public rules. Exact nationality, admission/host and age requirements are edition-specific as described above; no owner eligibility inferred. Individual applicant/recipient route published.

## 3. Application fields and files

Eligibility recognition followed by online project application through host-created applicant account; unit review and startup-park/district recommendation. Public complete form not read; no account created.

## 4. Deliverable

Science/technology research or qualifying technology enterprise; budget/task agreement and completion report. Existing public funding for same research excludes duplicate application. Research results acknowledge grant.

## 5. China attendance

2024 guide at least nine Shanghai work months/year after selection. Standing rules require second-review participation; absence relinquishes application.

## 6. Benefits and fees

Verified 2024: A/B RMB 300,000; C RMB 150,000/person; D RMB 150,000 social science, RMB 300,000 natural science/person or RMB 500,000/team. No assumption 2026 foreign scope/amounts unchanged. Fee status: unknown.

## 7. Expenses and IP

Funds paid to host against written agreement and ring-fenced budget. A/B use Shanghai science-project cost rules; C/D permitted research costs and personal living <=30%. Misuse/suspension consequences governed by standing rules; no organizer equity purchase identified.

## 8. Edition and dates

2024 foreign-naturalized eligibility verified; 2026 call indexed only. 2026 official call found in search index but live page shell and native TLS timeout prevented full read. 2024 quota/arrival cutoffs not carried to 2026. Current foreign-naturalized recognition, fees, contract recovery and academic IP unresolved.

## 9. Remaining gaps

2026 official call found in search index but live page shell and native TLS timeout prevented full read. 2024 quota/arrival cutoffs not carried to 2026. Current foreign-naturalized recognition, fees, contract recovery and academic IP unresolved.
